ch.locked: :no has had fabric back against it — it reads only.
ch.programmes_hint: The party's live programmes not on another challan. A programme goes out on one challan.
ch.none_free: This party has no live programme free to go out.
ch.no_lines_hint: A challan with no programmes carries nothing — add at least one.
ch.footer: The fabric comes back first to the floor, then into the store, against this challan.

rc.challan_hint: Its programmes are what can come back on this receipt.
rc.line_incomplete: Pick the programme and give the kilos.
rc.no_lines_hint: A receipt with no lines books nothing — add at least one programme.

hint.FLOOR: The floor's own check of the dyed fabric coming back, before the store will book it in.
hint.STORE: Dyed fabric booked back into the store against the challan — no more of a programme than the floor has received.

lines_hint.FLOOR: What came back of each programme on the challan, as the floor counted it.
lines_hint.STORE: What the store books back of each programme. A programme booked back in full is completed.

footer.FLOOR: The store books in only what the floor has received.
footer.STORE: The store books no more than the floor has received.

descriptions.approvals: Edits waiting for approval: each changed field with its current and new value. The entry keeps its values until the last approver approves.
descriptions.columns: The statement sheet's groups and columns: add or change columns, formulas, colour rules, widths, freeze panes and who sees each column.

card.docs_overdue_sub: BL + :days days passed, not at the bank

appr.empty: No edit is waiting for approval.
appr.no_approvers: nobody is set for this step
appr.note: Note (optional) — saved with Approve or Reject
appr.approved: Edit approved — the entry now shows the new values.
appr.next: Your approval is saved — the edit now waits for the next approver.
appr.rejected: Edit rejected — the entry keeps its previous values.
appr.withdrawn: Your edit was withdrawn — the entry is unchanged.

imp.hint: Norban's book or this page's export: a new Company Name + Invoice No. is added, an existing one is an edit.
imp.done: Import finished: :created new, :updated updated, :sent sent for approval, :unchanged unchanged.

master.norm_taken: There is already a norm for this template, category and method.
master.gsm_band: Give both ends of the GSM band, or tick Any.
master.gsm_order: GSM To cannot be below GSM From.

descriptions.planning-constraints-rules: The rules the planner may not break — capacity, shade sequence and lead time.
descriptions.batch-planning: Grey rolls gathered into batches and placed against capacity.
descriptions.factory-holiday-model: Non-working days the schedule plans around, per unit and shift.
descriptions.dyeing-machine-capacity-dashboard: Machine-wise load against capacity — where the plan still has room.
descriptions.batch-scheduling: Planned batches placed on a machine and a slot, in running order.
descriptions.fabric-planning-reports: The module's report set — batch plan, machine load and schedule adherence.

f.parent_help: Leave blank for a top-level area.
f.existing_help: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
f.name: Name
f.basis_help: Whether the board's columns run against shipment dates or booking dates.

area.records_title: Every measured area across the six constraint families, with its weighting
area.title: Plan Status Areas
area.hint: What each constraint family measures, and how much each measurement counts towards its score.
area.pick_hint: Its areas load beside it, and nothing is read from the database until you do.
area.foot: :n areas. The code is fixed once an area is created — it is what the scoring engine looks the area up by, and renaming it mid-season would silently orphan the rule that reads it.
area.empty: No areas under :group yet. Add the first one with Add area above.

rule.title: Plan Status Rules
rule.hint: Which band a family's score falls into, what it is called and what colour the board paints it.
rule.pick_hint: Its rules load beside it, and nothing is read from the database until you do.
rule.foot: :n rules. Bands within a group must not overlap: a score that matched two rules would take whichever the database returned first, and the board would change colour between refreshes.
rule.empty: No rules under :group yet. Add the first one with Add rule above.

bp.title: Batch Planning
bp.hint: Gather an order's fabric into batches, place them in a week and on a machine.
bp.none_yet: No records to choose from yet.
bp.lines_hint: Grey requirement against what is being planned. Balance is the difference and is not typed.
bp.no_lines_hint: A batch plan with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
bp.foot: The BP number is generated on save. Planned quantity is the sum of the fabric lines, so the header cannot claim a total the lines do not add up to.
bp.records_title: Batch plans by week, buyer and machine

hol.records_title: Closed days by unit, section and type
hol.title: Closed Days
hol.hint: Days this section does not run. The capacity board deducts them from the week.
hol.pick_hint: Its days load beside it, and nothing is read from the database until you do.
hol.new_day_hint: A working day is simply one with no row here, which is why the type list has no 'Working' in it.
hol.foot: :n days. A working day is simply one with no row here, which is why the type list has no 'Working' in it.
hol.empty: No days under :section. Add the first one with Close a day above.

cap.title: Machine Capacity
cap.hint: What each machine can take this week, and how much of it is already planned.
cap.pick_hint: Its machines load beside it, and nothing is read from the database until you do.
cap.no_weeks: No week has machine capacity yet.
cap.form_hint: Max Load in kilograms is derived from Capacity 100% and Max Load %, and the batches planned are counted from the plans themselves — neither is typed here.

sb.records_title: Scheduling boards, and how many batches each one carries
sb.title: Scheduled Batches
sb.hint: Batches placed on this plan, in running order. Move a batch to re-sequence it.
sb.pick_hint: Its batches load beside it, and nothing is read from the database until you do.
sb.once: A batch appears on a board once. Placing it again moves it rather than duplicating it, because two rows for one batch would each claim the same machine hours.
sb.foot: :n batches. A batch appears on a board once. Placing it again moves it rather than duplicating it, because two rows for one batch would each claim the same machine hours.
sb.moved: :no is already on this board — moved to the new slot.
sb.empty: No batches under :plan. Add the first one with Place batch on board above.
sb.form_hint: Batches are placed on a board, and moved earlier or later within it, on the Board tab.

rpt.title: Preview
rpt.hint: Pick a report to run it against live data. Rows can be exported from the grid.
rpt.pick_hint: Its rows load beside it, and nothing is read from the database until you do.
rpt.foot: :n row(s). Every figure here is read from the module's own tables at the moment you press the report. Nothing is cached.
rpt.empty: No rows for this report yet.
rpt.records_title: Report runs, with the unit, buyer and week they covered
rpt.form_hint: The catalogue is data, not a hard-coded list — a report can be added or retired without a deployment.

v.code_taken: This code is already used by another area or rule.
v.code_fixed: The code is fixed once created.
v.parent: The parent must be another area of the same status group.
v.parent_in_use: An area being removed is the parent of another area. Change that area first.
v.rank: Green Rank must be between 0 and 1.
v.band: Score To cannot be below Score From.
v.day_taken: This day is already closed for this unit.
v.capacity: Capacity 100% must be greater than zero.
v.week_days: W.days and HoliDays cannot add up to more than 7.
v.capacity_taken: This machine already has capacity for that week.
v.cell_width: Cell Width(%) must be greater than zero.
v.batch_once: A batch appears on a board once.
v.batch_cancelled: :no is cancelled and cannot be placed.
v.end_before_start: Planned End cannot be before Planned Start.
v.bp_qty: BP Qty must be greater than zero.
v.lines: A batch plan with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.line_qty: BP Qty must be greater than zero.

file.upload_failed: The file could not be uploaded. Try again.
file.type_not_allowed: Files of type :type are not accepted. Attach a photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC), a PDF or an Excel workbook (XLSX, XLS).
file.scan_pending: This file is still being checked. Try again in a moment.
file.infected: This file was rejected because a security check found a problem with it.
file.referenced_by_checklist: This file cannot be removed because a checklist result still points to it.

finance.gl_mapping_hint: Which two accounts each business event moves. Nothing in the system writes an account code, so pointing these at a real chart of accounts is a change here and nowhere else.
finance.gl_entries_hint: What each event has actually posted, looked up by the document number it came from.
finance.placeholder_notice: Every event starts pointed at a placeholder account so nothing is lost while the chart of accounts is being agreed. Re-point them here when finance signs off — no deployment is needed.

event_hints.GRN_COMPLETE: Stock arrives at the provisional rate on the receipt; the clearing account holds it until the supplier is billed.
event_hints.LANDED_COST_POST: Freight, duty and clearing lift what the stock is worth, against whoever is owed for them.
event_hints.ISSUE_TO_PRODUCTION: Material leaves the store for a cutting programme: out of stock, into work in progress.
event_hints.PURCHASE_RETURN: Goods go back out of the gate and the supplier is debited for them.
event_hints.ADVANCE_PAYMENT: Money paid to a mill before anything is delivered — owed back in goods.
event_hints.INVOICE_SETTLEMENT: A bill settled partly out of an advance already paid and partly from the bank.

finance.no_entries: Nothing has been posted to the books yet.

descriptions.process-types: The finishing processes a batch may be booked against — stenter, compacting, slitting, brushing.
descriptions.machine-profile: Each finishing machine's register entry: type, working width, capacity and the floor it stands on.
descriptions.machine-process-mapping: Which processes each machine is allowed to run, so a batch cannot be booked onto the wrong one.
descriptions.machine-target-setup: Daily output targeted per finishing machine, against which every shift's production is read.

process.hint: A process cannot link to itself, and one already named by a production line or a challan is deactivated rather than removed.
process.code_hint: Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore. Upper-cased on save.
process.short_hint: What the floor board and the challan print when the full name will not fit.
process.link_hint: The process this one normally follows. A hint the floor board reads, not a rule.
process.wip_hint: Where the floor status board shows a batch while this process is running.
process.loss_hint: Shrinkage the floor may book on this process without explaining it.

groups.title: Fabric Process Group
groups.hint: The groups processes are filed under, and the sub-groups inside each. A group is the top level the printed screen lists down its left-hand side; a sub-group is what the Process Sub-Group box on the form offers once a group is chosen.
groups.empty: Its sub-groups load beside it, and nothing is read from the database until you do.
groups.no_subgroups: Add the first one with Add Sub-Group above, then Save.
groups.footer: :count sub-groups. A sub-group with processes under it is withdrawn by clearing Active? rather than removed — the processes filed under it still name it.

machine.hint: Capacity and efficiency are what the floor board plans against, so both are bounded rather than free text. A machine already on a production sheet is deactivated rather than removed.
machine.no_hint: The number painted on the machine. The whole floor calls it by this.
machine.key_image_hint: A photograph of the nameplate. The path is stored; the bytes are not kept in the row.
machine.key_image_placeholder: Path or link, or attach a file

mapping.hint: A machine may be mapped to a process once per dia. The stage a batch enters at and the one it leaves at must differ — a step that changes nothing is a step the board cannot show.
mapping.sequence_hint: The order the floor works the processes in. Read by the board when it sorts a batch's remaining steps.

target.hint: A machine keeps one target per process, dia and effective date. Revising a target is a new row from the day it applies — overwriting would restate every month already read against the old one.
target.process_hint: Leave empty for a machine-wide target that every process is read against.

master.code_format: Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore only.
master.code_taken: There is already a process with this code.
master.subgroup_other_group: The sub-group belongs to another group.
master.link_self: A process cannot link to itself.
master.machine_taken: There is already a machine with this number.
master.status_same: Batch Status and Next Status must differ.
master.mapping_taken: This machine is already mapped to the process for that dia.
master.target_taken: This machine already has a target for that process, dia and date.
master.subgroup_in_use: A sub-group with processes under it cannot be removed — clear Active? instead.

prod.saved_note: Saved records are written to PostgreSQL and recorded in the audit trail.

h.receipt_note: A dyed batch handed over from the dyeing floor. Only batches dyed at least once and not on the floor already are offered. The number is given on save, and the batch starts at Awaiting Load.
h.batch: Dyed batches not on the floor yet.
h.dia: Open batches go through the open line, tube through the tube line; Both through either.
h.booking: Left blank, a sample batch is Sample and the rest In House.
h.challan_qty: As the Dye House's challan reads — the difference is shown on the register.
h.return_note: A batch sent back to the Dye House for correction. It leaves the floor, and can be received again once re-dyed.
h.card: Batches on the floor, not delivered or at a sub-contractor.
h.remarks_other: Required when the reason is Other.
h.amend_note: A correction to a posted production line, its old figures kept beside the new. A draft sheet is simply edited instead.
h.keep: Leave blank to keep what the line has.

records.empty_receipt: No batch has been received yet.
records.empty_receipt_hint: Add one on the Add New tab.
records.empty_return: No batch has been returned for re-processing.
records.empty_return_hint: Add one on the Add New tab.
records.empty_amendment_hint: Add one on the Add New tab.

sheet.hint_OPEN: A shift's finishing production on the open line. Each row is one batch through one machine on one process; the difference between what went in and what came off is the process loss the floor answers for.
sheet.hint_TUBE: A shift's finishing production on the tube line. Each row is one batch through one machine on one process; the difference between what went in and what came off is the process loss the floor answers for.
sheet.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
sheet.line_hint: Fixed by the sheet you are on. The other line has its own tab.
sheet.lines_hint: One row per batch through one machine. Load and unload times are what the floor board reads its Spent Time from, so they are worth entering even when the shift is obvious.
sheet.no_lines_hint: A sheet with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
sheet.footer: Saving keeps the sheet as a draft. Posting it — from the register — is what moves each batch to the stage its machine and process are mapped to, so a sheet can be corrected right up until the board has acted on it.
sheet.footer_posted: This sheet is posted and reads only — a correction goes through Finishing Production Amendment.
sheet.line_incomplete: Pick the batch, machine and process, and give what went in.
sheet.not_mapped: That machine is not mapped to this process on this line.
sheet.totals: Input :in kg · Output :out kg · Loss :loss kg (:pct%)
sheet.no_choices: No records to choose from yet.

reg.summary: :count sheet(s). A sheet is rewritten only while it is a draft — posting is what moves the batches.
reg.empty: No production sheet has been raised yet.
reg.empty_hint: Start one on the Open Line or Tube Line tab.
reg.post_text: Each batch on :no moves to the stage its machine and process are mapped to. A posted sheet reads only.
reg.delete_text: The draft :no and its lines will be removed.

board.hint: Leaving the boxes empty shows the whole floor. Spent Time is counted from the last load, on the server. S/C Prod. opens the sub-contract challan desk and BT Trans. the hand-over to the finished fabric store.
board.empty_hint: Change the search above and load again.
board.deliver_hint: The batch moves from :stage to the stage you pick; the move is written to its trail.

descriptions.batch-receive-from-dyeing: Dyed batches handed over from the dyeing floor, roll and weight checked against the challan.
descriptions.df-production-entry-mc-wise: Shift-wise finishing output per machine, with process, shade, GSM and finished width.
descriptions.df-process-wise-delivery: A batch passed from one finishing process to the next, so the trail is complete end to end.
descriptions.batch-return-to-re-process: Batches sent back for shade, GSM or width correction, with the reason recorded against them.
descriptions.df-production-amendment: Corrections to a posted production entry — quantity, process or machine — kept auditable.

v.recv_qty: Received Qty (Kg) must be more than nothing.
v.receipt_returned: :no was returned for re-processing and reads only.
v.batch_fixed: Production has been entered against :no, so its batch stays.
v.batch_closed: Batch :batch is replaced or closed — it is not handed over.
v.batch_on_floor: Batch :batch is on the floor already, under :no.
v.batch_not_dyed: Batch :batch has not been through a dyeing machine yet.
v.before_dyed: Batch :batch was first dyed on :date — it cannot be received before that.
v.receipt_has_production: Production has been entered against :no, so it stays.
v.receipt_moved: :no has moved on the floor or been returned, so it stays.
v.return_qty: Qty (Kg) must be more than nothing.
v.other_reason: Say what the other reason is in Remarks.
v.return_card_fixed: The batch of :no is fixed — undo it and return the right one.
v.card_gone: Batch :batch is :stage — it is not returned from the floor.
v.return_before_receipt: A return cannot be dated before its receipt :no.
v.return_over: No more than the :kg kg received can be returned.
v.received_again: The batch of :no has been received again (:receipt), so the return stays.
v.input: Input (Kg) must be more than nothing.
v.amend_stands: :no stands as made — a further correction is a further amendment.
v.amend_draft: :no is still a draft — edit it on the production entry instead.
v.amend_before: An amendment cannot be dated before its sheet :no.
v.output_over: Output (Kg) cannot be more than the input.
v.not_mapped_plain: That machine is not mapped to that process on the :line.
v.amend_nothing: Nothing has changed — the line already reads so.
v.no_lines: A sheet with no lines posts nothing — add at least one.
v.post_returned: Batch :batch (:no) has left the floor since — take its row off before posting.
v.post_unmapped: Batch :batch's machine is no longer mapped to its process on this line.
v.to_stage: Pick the stage the batch goes to.
v.desk_stage: Delivered and At Sub-Contract are set by their own desks, not here.
v.same_stage: The batch is at that stage already.
v.line_fixed: A sheet's line is fixed — the other line has its own sheet.
v.row_off_floor: Row :n: batch :batch is not on the floor.
v.row_wrong_line: Row :n: batch :batch is received as :dia — it does not go through the :line.
v.row_before_receipt: Row :n: batch :batch was received on :date, after this sheet's date.
v.row_output_over: Row :n: output cannot be more than the input.
v.row_unmapped: Row :n: that machine is not mapped to that process on the :line.
v.row_unload_before: Row :n: the unload time cannot be before the load time.
v.sheet_posted: :no is posted and reads only — correct it through the Amendment.

list.empty_hint: Change the search above and load again.

ed.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.

challan.title: S/C Program Challan
challan.hint: Fabric leaving the finishing floor for a sub-contract processor. Each line is one shade against one order; the gate pass number is written on it as the lorry goes through, so a challan without one is one that has not left yet.
challan.gate_hint: Written by security when the lorry leaves. Left blank until it does.
challan.lines_hint: One line per shade. What has come back against each is recounted from the receipts and is not typed here.
challan.line_incomplete: Pick the process, give the kilos, and name the batch or the lot.
challan.no_lines_hint: A challan with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
challan.footer: Saving keeps the challan a draft. Posting it — from the register — is what marks its batches as out at the processor.
challan.footer_locked: This challan is posted or cancelled and reads only.
challan.list_hint: An empty search lists the most recent challans. The Received column is recounted from the receipts, not typed.
challan.pointer: A challan is raised on the entry tab, where its shades are picked. Add New opens it.

receipt.title: Receive S/C Finish Fabric at Store
receipt.hint: Finished fabric taken back from a processor. Each line answers the challan line it went out on, which is what makes 'what does this party still hold' a query rather than a reconciliation somebody does by eye.
receipt.challan_hint: The challan this fabric went out on. Leaving it blank books an unmatched return, which the party balance cannot net off.
receipt.lines_hint: Short weight is what the processor lost on the run, weighed back at the gate. It is entered rather than derived because the party disputes it, and a figure nobody typed is a figure nobody owns.
receipt.line_incomplete: Give what came back, or the short weight.
receipt.no_lines_hint: A receipt with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
receipt.footer: Saving keeps the receipt a draft. Posting it — from the register — is what credits the challan lines it answers.
receipt.footer_locked: This receipt is posted and reads only.
receipt.list_hint: An empty search lists the most recent receipts.
receipt.pointer: A receipt is written on the entry tab, against the challan it answers. Add New opens it.

bill.title: S/C Program Bill
bill.hint: The processor's bill against what it returned. The amount on each line is quantity times rate, recomputed on save — a total somebody can type is a total that can disagree with the lines it claims to add up.
bill.lines_hint: One line per process charged, against the challan it was done under. The rate defaults from the process but is the party's to quote, so it stays editable.
bill.line_incomplete: Pick the challan and the process, and give the kilos.
bill.no_lines_hint: A bill with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
bill.footer: A bill is rewritten while it is a draft or submitted. Once it is completed it is what the mill paid against, and it stands.
bill.footer_locked: This bill is completed or cancelled and reads only.
bill.list_hint: An empty search lists the most recent bills.
bill.pointer: A bill is written on the entry tab, against the challans it charges for. Add New opens it.

reg.post_challan_text: Every batch on :no is marked as out at the processor. A posted challan reads only.
reg.cancel_challan_text: Nothing has come back against :no; if it was posted, its batches return to the floor at the stage they left from.
reg.post_receipt_text: The challan lines :no answers are credited, and a batch whose lines are all answered comes back onto the floor. A posted receipt reads only.
reg.submit_bill_text: The bill can still be corrected while submitted.
reg.complete_bill_text: A completed bill is what the mill paid against, and it stands.
reg.cancel_bill_text: A cancelled bill no longer counts against what came back.

balance.hint: Balance is the challan's quantity less every posted receipt against it. Nothing here is stored — it is counted at the moment you look.
balance.empty: No open line matches that search
balance.empty_hint: Change the search above and load again.

descriptions.sc-delivery-challan-gatepass: Fabric leaving the floor for a sub-contract processor, with its challan and gate pass.
descriptions.sc-receive-finished: Finished fabric taken back from the processor, checked against what was sent out.
descriptions.sc-process-bill-entry: The processor's bill against a delivery, rated by process and quantity received.
descriptions.sc-party-wise-balance: What each processor still holds: delivered against received, open lot by open lot.

v.no_lines_challan: A challan with no shades on it sends nothing to the processor.
v.row_what: Row :n: name the batch, or give the lot or a description of the goods.
v.row_off_floor: Row :n: batch :batch is not on the floor.
v.row_over_card: Row :n: no more of batch :batch can go out than the :kg kg received.
v.post_off_floor: Batch :batch has left the floor since — take its line off before posting.
v.challan_answered: Fabric has come back or been billed against :no, so it is not cancelled.
v.challan_locked: :no is :status — it is not changed here.
v.no_lines_receipt: A receipt with no lines posts nothing — add at least one.
v.challan_not_posted: :no is not posted — nothing is received against it.
v.party_of_challan: The party is the one :no went out to.
v.receipt_before_challan: A receipt cannot be dated before its challan :no.
v.row_not_on_challan: Row :n: that line is not on the challan picked.
v.row_nothing: Row :n: give what came back, or the short weight.
v.row_over_balance: Row :n: only :kg kg is still out on that line.
v.no_lines_bill: A bill with no lines charges nothing — add at least one.
v.bill_twice: The party's bill :no is entered already.
v.row_challan_party: Row :n: :no is not a posted challan of this party.
v.row_process_not_sent: Row :n: nothing went out on :no for that process.
v.row_over_received: Row :n: only :kg kg has come back and not been billed for that process on that challan.
v.bill_stands: :no is completed or cancelled and stands.
v.bill_step: :no is :status — that step does not follow.

qc.saved_note: Saved records are written to PostgreSQL and recorded in the audit trail.

h.card: Batches on the floor, not delivered or at a sub-contractor.
h.roll_no: The roll's tag number — once per batch.
h.defect: Required when the roll is faulty.
h.entry_note: One roll as it comes off the machine: its weight, GSM, dia and shade, and whether it is faulty.
h.decision_batch: One decision per batch — a batch already on the queue is opened from the list, not added twice.
h.decided_by: Left blank, whoever saves the decision is recorded as deciding it.
h.decision_note: Buyer, order, style, colour and quantity follow the batch unless given here.
h.decision_list: An empty search shows every batch still waiting on a decision, newest first.
h.inspection_list: The roll box takes a scanned barcode as readily as a typed number — it finds the inspection the roll is on.
h.inspection: Posted inspections that rejected the batch or some of its rolls, not yet advised.
h.machine: A machine mapped to the process for the batch’s dia.
h.remarks_other: Required when the reason is Other.
h.advice_note: The re-process advised on what an inspection rejected. Its rolls and kilos are counted from the inspection; the held batch goes back to Awaiting Load to be run again.

records.empty_entry: No roll has been read yet.
records.empty_decision: No shade decision matches that search
records.empty_advice: No re-process has been advised yet.
records.empty_hint: Change the search above and load again.

reg.post_text: The verdict on :no is recorded against the batch: a pass sends it on to the store, a hold or a reject stops it on the floor board. A posted inspection reads only.

ed.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.

insp.title: Finish Fabric Inspection
insp.hint: Load a batch, take the lab readings from its cut sample, then weigh and grade its rolls. The four-point count is per roll because that is what a roll is graded on; the lab report is per batch because that is how it is measured.
insp.batch_hint: Loading a batch brings its buyer, order, style and colour with it — they belong to the batch, not to this sheet.
insp.ref_hint: Left blank, the sheet is numbered when it is saved.
insp.verdict_hint: A hold stops the batch on the floor board; a pass sends it on to the store.
insp.rolls_hint: One row per roll. The roll number is the one on the tag — scanned or typed, it is the same string — and it has to be unique within this sheet.
insp.line_incomplete: Give the roll number, its weight and its result.
insp.roll_twice: Roll :roll is on this sheet already.
insp.no_rolls_hint: An inspection with no rolls posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
insp.footer: Saving keeps the sheet a draft and recounts its three totals. Posting it — from the register — is what records the verdict against the batch and moves it on the floor board.
insp.footer_posted: This inspection is posted and reads only.
insp.pointer: An inspection is written on the entry tab, where the batch is loaded and its rolls are weighed.

descriptions.finishing-qc-entry: Roll-wise quality entry taken as the batch comes off the machine.
descriptions.shade-gsm-width-check: The three readings a finished batch is passed on, against the buyer's approved standard.
descriptions.fabric-inspection-4-point: Four-point inspection with defect points per roll and the grade each roll earns.
descriptions.qc-rejection-re-process-advice: Rolls a QC check rejected, and the re-process the floor is advised to run on them.

v.card_off_floor: Batch :batch is not on the floor.
v.weight: Weight (Kg) must be more than nothing.
v.defect: Name the defect of a faulty roll.
v.before_receipt: This cannot be dated before the batch was received (:no).
v.roll_twice: Roll :roll of batch :batch is read already.
v.on_queue: Batch :batch is on the queue already — open it from the Batch List.
v.other_reason: Say what the other reason is in Remarks.
v.nothing_rejected: :no is not a posted inspection that rejected anything.
v.advice_before: An advice cannot be dated before its inspection :no.
v.machine_not_mapped: That machine is not mapped to that process for the batch's dia.
v.advice_acted: The batch has moved on since :no, so it stays.
v.no_rolls: An inspection with no rolls posts nothing — add at least one.
v.roll_on_sheet: Row :n: roll :roll is on this sheet already.

h.roll_no: The roll's tag number — once per lot. The barcode is given on save.
h.roll_note: A roll racked in the store. Its barcode is numbered here, and a lot's rolls never weigh more than the lot received.
h.kind: A return comes back from cutting into the lot; a transfer leaves the lot for another unit.
h.requisition: For a return: the requisition the fabric went out on.
h.to_unit: For a transfer: the unit it goes to.
h.return_note: Fabric returned from cutting or sent to another unit. The lot's balance moves with it.
h.qty_len: Give the length; the kilos follow from the lot when left blank.

records.empty_roll: No roll has been racked yet.
records.empty_return: Nothing has been returned or transferred yet.
records.empty_hint: Change the search above and load again.

reg.send_text: The trolley leaves: every batch on :no is Delivered off the floor board, and the store can receive it.
reg.receive_text: Each line of :no becomes a lot in the store — only then does the stock exist.

ed.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.

delivery.title: Delivery to Finish Fabric Store
delivery.hint: Hand passed rolls to the finished fabric store. Everything the store will rack the lot by travels on the line — the description, the shade, the GSM and the dia — because after this note there is nowhere else those could come from.
delivery.lines_hint: One line per batch lot. Grey Qty is what went in and Finish Qty is what is being handed over — the store's yield report is the two read together, so both are asked for.
delivery.line_incomplete: Pick the batch and give the grey and finish quantities.
delivery.no_lines_hint: A delivery with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
delivery.footer: Every lot on one note must belong to the same order — the store books a receipt per order, and guessing which one to file a mixed note under is how fabric goes missing. Send it from the register when the trolley leaves.
delivery.footer_locked: This delivery has been sent and reads only.
delivery.empty: No delivery note matches that search
delivery.list_hint: Sending a delivery raises a draft receipt in the receiving store. The store posts it, and only then does the stock exist.
delivery.pointer: A delivery is written on the entry tab, where the batch lots are picked. Add New opens it.

req.title: Finish Fabric Issue to Cutting
req.hint: A cutting floor's request for finished fabric, and what the store released against it. Each line names a lot the store actually holds, so a requisition cannot ask for stock that is not there.
req.status_hint: Partial or Complete releases the issued kilos from the lots; Draft or Cancelled releases nothing.
req.lines_hint: Req Qty is what cutting asked for; Issue Qty is what the store released. A line released beyond the lot's balance is refused — the balance is re-read here, not taken from the grid.
req.line_incomplete: Pick the lot and give what cutting asked for.
req.no_lines_hint: A requisition with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
req.footer: The requisition records the ask and the release; the release moves the lots. A complete or cancelled requisition stands.
req.footer_locked: This requisition is complete or cancelled and reads only.
req.list_hint: An empty search lists the most recent requisitions across every cutting floor.
req.pointer: A requisition is written on the entry tab, where the lots are picked off the store's stock. Add New opens it.

descriptions.finish-fabric-store-receive: Passed rolls taken into the finished fabric store against a finishing delivery.
descriptions.roll-wise-racking-barcode: Where each roll is racked and the barcode it carries, so it can be found again.
descriptions.fabric-issue-to-cutting: Rolls released from the store to a cutting floor against a fabric requisition.
descriptions.fabric-store-return-transfer: Rolls returned from cutting or transferred to another unit, with the balance adjusted.

v.not_ready: Batch :batch is not Ready for Delivery any more — take its line off before sending.
v.no_lots: A hand-over with no lots on it hands over nothing.
v.row_not_ready: Row :n: batch :batch is not Ready for Delivery — it has not passed inspection.
v.row_twice: Row :n: batch :batch is on this note twice.
v.row_finish_over: Row :n: the finish quantity cannot be more than the grey.
v.one_order: Every lot on one note must belong to the same order.
v.delivery_locked: :no is :status — it is not changed here.
v.no_lines: A requisition with no lines posts nothing — add at least one.
v.row_other_store: Row :n: lot :lot is not in the store picked.
v.row_over_length: Row :n: lot :lot holds :len :unit — no more can be issued.
v.row_kg_needed: Row :n: give the kilos too — lot :lot has no length or GSM and width to work them out.
v.not_complete: A requisition is complete only when every line is released in full.
v.nothing_issued: A partial requisition has released something — give an Issue Qty.
v.weight: Weight (Kg) must be more than nothing.
v.rolls_over_lot: The rolls of :lot would weigh more than it received — only :kg kg is left to rack.
v.qty: Qty (Kg) must be more than nothing.
v.to_unit: Name the unit a transfer goes to.
v.requisition: Name the requisition a return comes back from.
v.before_lot: This cannot be dated before :lot was received.
v.return_over: Only :kg kg released on :no is still out.
v.return_used: The fabric :no brought back has gone out again, so it stays.

descriptions.dyeing-finishing-report: Every finishing report Brickland lists — production, sub-contract, quality, store and stock — read at the moment Preview is pressed.

hint.finishing: Pick a report and the boxes it reads; empty boxes take in everything on file. Nothing here changes a record.

desc.finishing: read from the Finishing Line at the moment Preview was pressed.

rpt.excel_hint: Every row on one page, ready for Export.
rpt.empty: Nothing to show for these boxes
rpt.empty_hint: Widen the dates or clear a box and preview again.
rpt.no_choices: No records to choose from yet.

pending.aop: AOP is not built yet — this report fills once its screens exist.
pending.booking: Fabric booking's fibre composition and colour groups are not kept yet — this report fills once they are.

v.window: To Date cannot be before From Date.

report.daily-production: Daily Production Report of Dyeing Finishing
report.mc-production-vs-target: DF M/C Wise Production Against Target
report.sc-party-production-summary: Party wise S/C Dyeing & Dyeing Finishing Production Summary
report.mc-reprocess-with-reason: M/C Wise Finishing Re-Process Qty with Reason
report.sc-party-production-register: Party wise S/C Dyeing & Dyeing Finishing Production Register
report.wet-dry-hold-24hr: Dyeing - Finishing Floor 24hr Wet & Only Dry Hold Fabric
report.left-over-utilization: Utilization of Left-Over Finish Fabric – Transfer and Re-Use
report.fiber-colour-booking: Fiber Composition and Color Group Wise Fabric Booking

descriptions.gp-categories: Main Gate Pass (Employee) and Item Gate Pass (Product/Material), and the two gate pass types.
descriptions.gp-location-types: Embroidery, Printing, Washing, Finishing, Dyeing, Testing Laboratory, Buyer Office, Supplier and more.
descriptions.gp-locations: The factories and places outside the gate goods go to, with who to reach there.
descriptions.gp-items: What an item gate pass carries out — garments, fabric, trims, samples, machinery, documents — and its unit.
descriptions.gp-purposes: Why goods or people go out — Embroidery, Printing, Washing, Repair, Sample Approval, Buyer Submission…

types.title: Gate Pass Types
types.hint: Fixed by the module’s logic — every gate pass is one of the two.

returnable.title: OUT & IN — Returnable
returnable.body: Goes out and comes back: OUT → External Location → IN → Reconciliation → CLOSED. Gate IN is enabled.

non_returnable.title: OUT ONLY — Non-Returnable
non_returnable.body: Goes out for good: OUT → COMPLETED. No Gate IN, no return or short quantity.

f.name: Name
f.active_hint: Inactive entries are not offered on new gate passes.

master.code_taken: This code is already in use.

descriptions.gp-dashboard: Today OUT and IN, pending, partial and overdue returns, short quantity, and movement by purpose and location.
descriptions.gp-reports: Register, OUT, IN, pending and overdue return, short quantity, and location-, purpose-, employee- and item-wise reports.
descriptions.gp-create: Main Gate Pass for an employee or Item Gate Pass for goods — OUT & IN (Returnable) or OUT ONLY — with destination, carrier and items.
descriptions.gp-approval: Approve or reject gate passes waiting for approval; send an approved pass back for amendment.
descriptions.gp-out: Gate Security scans the QR / barcode, checks the approved pass, items, destination and carrier, and confirms OUT.
descriptions.gp-in: Scan a returnable pass; the OUT details load and only the return quantity is entered — partial, full or short.
descriptions.gp-reconciliation: OUT against IN for every returnable pass: balance, short quantity and reason, and the approver’s close.
descriptions.gp-list: Search every gate pass by number, date, employee, item, buyer, style, PO, destination, purpose, type and status.

f.card_hint: Enter the employee card number and search — name, ID, department, designation and photo load from the Employee master.
f.no_locations: No locations yet — add them under Master Data → Factory / Location.
f.no_items: Add items under Master Data → Item / Product.
f.name: Name

toast.approved: :no approved. Gate Security can now let it out.
toast.closed: :no closed with the short on record.

dialog.approve_body: Once approved, Gate Security can let it out. It can only be changed afterwards by sending it back for amendment.
dialog.reject_body: The gate pass cannot go out. Whoever prepared it sees the reason.
dialog.send_back_body: It becomes a draft again, to be changed and submitted for approval once more.
dialog.cancel_body: It can no longer go out. It stays on record as Cancelled.
dialog.out_body: OUT date, time and your name are recorded. The pass is then owed back through Gate IN.
dialog.out_body_once: OUT date, time and your name are recorded. An OUT ONLY pass is then complete.
dialog.in_main: The employee is back; the gate pass closes.
dialog.close_body: You are authorising the short quantity. The gate pass closes and the short stays on record.

panel.name: Name
panel.no_items: A Main Gate Pass carries no items.

approval.waiting_hint: Oldest first. Click a gate pass to review, approve or reject it.
approval.approved_hint: An approved gate pass is changed only by sending it back for amendment.
approval.approved_empty: No approved gate pass is waiting at the gate.

gate.scan: Gate Pass No. / Barcode / QR Scan
gate.click_load: Click a row to load it.
gate.not_ready_out: :no is :status — only an approved gate pass can go out.
gate.not_ready_in: :no is :status — only a returnable gate pass that is out can come back in.
gate.final: Final return — nothing more is coming back
gate.final_hint: The remaining balance is declared short and needs an approver to close.
gate.stays: :qty stays out — the pass becomes PARTIALLY RETURNED.
gate.all_back: Everything is back — the gate pass closes.
gate.declared: :qty will be declared SHORT (:reason). An approver must close it.
gate.main_back: An employee gate pass — Confirm IN records that the employee is back.

recon.title: OUT vs IN
recon.hint: Short = OUT − total IN, worked out by the system. Click a row for line-wise detail.
recon.empty: No returnable item gate pass is out.
recon.banner: :count gate pass is short and waiting for your approval to close.
recon.banner_many: :count gate passes are short and waiting for your approval to close.
recon.short_line: :qty short — :reason. Waiting for an approver to close it.

list.title: Gate Passes (:count)
list.hint: Click a row to open it.
list.empty: No gate pass matches this filter.

dash.returns_empty: No returnable gate pass has gone out yet.
dash.overdue_hint: Expected Return Date has passed and it has not fully come back.

v.no_employee: No employee with card no. :card was found.
v.return_before: The expected return date cannot be before the gate pass date.
v.line_qty: Row :n: enter a quantity above zero.
v.not_approved: :no is not an approved gate pass.
v.not_out: :no is not a returnable gate pass that is out.
v.not_short: :no is not short and waiting to close.
v.in_over: :item: no more than :qty can come back.
v.in_none: Enter a return quantity, or tick Final return.

rpt.empty: Nothing to report for this filter.

descriptions.employee-type: Permanent, probation, contract and casual, each with its own entitlements.
descriptions.designation-group: The categories designations are grouped under, and the manpower category (Operator, Quality, Helper, Supervisor, Staff) each counts as.
descriptions.grade: Pay grades used by employees and salary structures.
descriptions.pay-element: Earnings and deductions: basic, house rent, medical, food, transport and the rest.
descriptions.allowance-entry: Allowances payable to employees for a pay period, entered or uploaded.
descriptions.head-wise-deduction: Deductions against employees for a pay period, by deduction head.
descriptions.shift-master: Shift times, break, working hours, grace time, cross-day and OT settings, effective-dated.
descriptions.leave-type: Leave types, paid or unpaid, with eligibility and balance rules.
descriptions.ot-rule: How an OT hour is priced — wage basis, hourly formula, multiplier — by effective date, category and grade.
descriptions.bonus-rules-setup: Festival bonus rules by service length, salary band, basis and percentage.
descriptions.salary-policy-and-rules: Wage gazettes and the salary structures under them, versioned by effective date.
descriptions.gazette-grade-wage: What each gazette fixes per grade — Basic, House Rent, allowances — and the Gross-A letters print.
descriptions.festival-calendar: Eid-ul-Fitr, Eid-ul-Adha and other festivals by year, the month each bonus is paid in, and the holidays attendance reads.
descriptions.company-pay-period: Pay periods, the salary day basis, late deduction rule and rounding payroll is processed with.

et.hint: Type Level is derived from the parent on save.
et.level_hint: One below the parent type. A type with no parent sits at level 1.
et.tree_hint: Select a node to see the types filed under it. What you select becomes the Parent Type of anything you add.
et.select_node: Please select a node for operation
et.select_node_hint: Its types load beside it, and nothing is read from the database until you do.
et.no_children: Add the first one with New above.
et.footer: :count types. Type Level is the parent's level plus one and is not typed — the printed form greys it out for the same reason. A node stops being a leaf the moment it gets a child, and becomes one again when its last child goes.
et.tree_form_hint: Type Level is the parent's level plus one and is not typed — the printed form greys it out for the same reason. A node stops being a leaf the moment it gets a child, and becomes one again when its last child goes.

dg.hint: Group Level is derived from the parent on save.
dg.level_hint: One below the parent — picking Chairman puts this group directly under it.
dg.manpower_hint: What the HR and Company dashboards count this group's employees as. Empty = read from the designation title.

gr.hint: The same grades as Company Management → Designation & Grade: a grade is kept once and read by both.

pe.hint: Every element needs a GL mapping before payroll can post it — see Payroll Element Map.

al.hint: One entry per element per employee per period; re-entering the same trio replaces the amount. Choose Excel Upload to bring a file in instead — the Excel Upload tab stages it, checks every line and applies only the clean ones.
al.excel_hint: Excel Upload is the tab beside this one — a file is staged and checked before anything is paid.

de.hint: One deduction per head per employee per period — the same head cannot be deducted twice.
de.company_hint: The company the chosen pay period belongs to.

up.hint_allowance: Attach an allowance file, check every line against the employee register and the chosen period, then apply the clean rows.
up.hint_deduction: Attach a deduction file, check every line against the employee, head and period registers, then apply the clean rows.
up.columns_allowance: Columns: employee_code, amount. The Template button downloads a sample.
up.columns_deduction: Columns: employee_code, pay_element (the head code, e.g. MED), amount. The Template button downloads a sample.
up.element_hint: The element every line in this file is for.
up.company_hint: The company every line in this file belongs to.
up.period_hint: Used for any line whose Pay Period Id column is blank.
up.carries: Attach a delimited file whose header row carries: :headers.
up.rule_allowance: A line is applied only if its employee code resolves to somebody active in the company above, and that element is not already entered for them in that period. Nothing is written until Upload — Show File Data checks and shows, it does not save.
up.rule_deduction: A line is applied only if its employee code and deduction head both resolve, its pay period is open and belongs to the company above, and that head is not already deducted from that employee for that period. Nothing is written until Upload — Show File Data checks and shows, it does not save.

sh.hint: The attendance engine reads the shift for every punch: late minutes from start + grace, early out and OT from the regular end. A night shift's OUT punch is taken on the next day.
sh.start_hint: Arriving after start + grace is late, counted from the start (08:00 + 15: 08:10 is on time, 08:16 is 16 minutes late).
sh.break_hint: Clock time the break begins, e.g. 13:00. Blank = the middle of the shift.
sh.hours_hint: Regular hours; the rest of the shift is overtime. Leave blank to take the span less the break.
sh.grace_hint: Blank uses Payroll Settings → Default Grace Minutes.
sh.cross_hint: Set automatically when the end is before the start (22:00 – 06:00).

lt.hint: Leave Group decides whether a day under this type counts as leave, present or absent — attendance and payroll both branch on it.

ot.hint: Hourly rate = wage basis ÷ divisor × multiplier. When several rules apply to an employee on a day, the one naming their grade wins, then the one naming their category, then the general rule.
ot.divisor_hint: Monthly wage ÷ this = one ordinary hour (208 = 26 days × 8 hours).
ot.to_hint: Leave blank while the rule is current.

bo.hint: Department, designation group and team narrow a rule — leave them empty to apply it to everyone of that employee type. When several rules match, the one naming the most wins.
bo.set_hint: The set a festival names on the Festival Calendar. Only rules in that set price its bonus.
bo.months_hint: In months, completed on the festival date.
bo.amount_hint: A percentage of the basis, or a fixed amount below — one of the two.

wg.title: Wage Gazette
wg.hint: Declare a wage board gazette — number, year, industry, effective date and reference — the policies published under it, and read its salary structure per category.
wg.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
wg.effective_hint: The date the board's rates take effect. Compliance checks read the newest gazette in force on a date.
wg.active_hint: Status. A superseded gazette stays active for the employees still on it; untick only one nobody uses.
wg.reference_placeholder: https://… link to the published gazette, or a file path
wg.policies_hint: The named rules this gazette publishes. A code is unique within the gazette, so the same code may recur under a later one.
wg.structure_hint: What this gazette sets per employee category, read from the structure lines on the Records tab: Basic is the multiplier the gross is divided by, House Rent a percentage of Basic, the rest amounts in taka.
wg.no_structure: No structure lines under this gazette yet.
wg.versioning: A new wage board is a new gazette with its own effective date — the old one stays as it was, so payslips made under it still read true and employees move to the new one as their structures are re-set.
wg.delete_confirm: Delete this gazette and its policies?
wg.line_hint: A new wage board is a new gazette (Wage Gazette tab) with its own lines here. Lines of an older gazette stay for the employees and payslips made under it.
wg.amount_hint: Basic Pay: the divisor (Basic = (Gross − fixed allowances) ÷ it). House Rent: % of Basic. Gross Pay: the Gross Minimum salaries are checked against. Any other element: taka.

gg.hint: Gross-A = Basic + House Rent + Medical + Conveyance + Food + Other. Letters read the line for the employee's gazette, category and grade.

fe.hint: The date is set for each year — never assumed. The bonus rule set decides who is eligible and how much.
fe.date_hint: Each year’s Eid-ul-Fitr, Eid-ul-Adha and other festivals are entered on their own.
fe.month_hint: The payroll month the bonus is paid with.
fe.rule_hint: The rule set on Bonus Rule that prices this festival's bonus.
fe.service_hint: Completed on the festival date. 0 for none.
fe.eligibility_placeholder: e.g. Confirmed employees with the minimum service on the festival date
fe.reference_placeholder: Moon-sighting notice, government circular or board decision
fe.holiday_hint: Files the days in the holiday register and puts them on the attendance calendar.
fe.holiday_form_hint: Written to the holiday register attendance reads; a dated holiday is put on the calendar straight away.
fe.delete_holiday: A holiday that has put days on the calendar is kept — deactivate it instead. Days already on the calendar are never overwritten.
fe.recurring_hint: Only for holidays fixed in the Gregorian calendar.
fe.footer: :count festival(s). One with a bonus run against it is kept; mark it Inactive instead.
fe.delete_festival: One with a bonus run against it is kept; mark it Inactive instead.

pp.hint: The pay period number is generated on save from the company, year and month — it is not typed.
pp.no_hint: Generated on save from the company, year and month.
pp.search_hint: Leave a box empty to ignore it. An empty panel loads every period, newest pay date first. Part of a number is enough — it matches anywhere in it.

ps.settings_hint: The salary day basis, late deduction rule and rounding every salary screen is computed with. Type over a value and Save.
ps.settings_footer: :count settings. Changes apply to the next Calculate on Daily and Monthly Salary — figures already approved or finalized are not recomputed. Only Salary Finalize holders (HR Admin, Factory Manager) can change these.

SALARY_DAY_BASIS.label: Salary Day Basis
SALARY_DAY_BASIS.what: A month's salary ÷ this = one day's wage (daily salary, absence, late).

LATE_DEDUCTION_MODE.label: Late Deduction Mode
LATE_DEDUCTION_MODE.what: LATE_DAYS: every N late days cost one day's wage, decided monthly. PER_MINUTE: each late minute costs a day's wage ÷ 480.

LATE_DAYS_PER_DEDUCTION.label: Late Days per Deduction
LATE_DAYS_PER_DEDUCTION.what: N in “every N late days = one day's wage” (LATE_DAYS mode).

LATE_DEDUCTION_BASIS.label: Late Deduction Basis
LATE_DEDUCTION_BASIS.what: The wage a late day or late minute is priced from.

DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES.label: Default Grace Minutes
DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES.what: Grace for a shift that does not carry its own (HR-17).

ROUND_NET_TO.label: Round Net To (taka)
ROUND_NET_TO.what: Net pay is rounded down to this note size; 1 = no rounding.

ps.actions_hint: Move a pay period through its life — submit it for activation, activate it, close it.
ps.select_company_hint: Its pay periods load beside it, and nothing is read from the database until you do.
ps.no_periods: Add one on the New pay period tab.
ps.actions_footer: :count pay periods. The totals are what salary processing wrote — they are read here, never typed. Only the transitions its current status allows will succeed; the rest are refused with the reason.
ps.fy_hint: The fiscal and calendar year a pay period is filed under. Create one here without leaving the screen.
ps.select_register_hint: Its fiscal years load beside it, and nothing is read from the database until you do.
ps.no_years: Add the first one with Add year, then Save.
ps.fy_footer: :count fiscal years. The fiscal year is the accounting year a period is reported in; the calendar year is the one it falls in. They differ in Bangladesh — a July-to-June fiscal year spans two calendar years — which is why both are asked for.

master.parent_cycle: A row cannot sit under itself or anything filed under it.
master.type_taken: There is already an employee type with this name.
master.group_taken: There is already a designation group with this name.
master.grade_taken: There is already a grade with this number.
master.element_taken: There is already a pay element with this code.
master.shift_taken: There is already a shift with this code.
master.time_format: Enter the time as HH:MM, e.g. 08:00.
master.leave_taken: There is already a leave type with this code.
master.ot_taken: There is already an OT rule with this code.
master.effective_order: Effective To cannot be before Effective From.
master.band_order: The high limit cannot be below the low one (0 means no upper limit).
master.bonus_amount_required: Give a bonus percentage or a fixed bonus.
master.amount_positive: The amount must be more than zero.
master.line_taken: This gazette already sets this pay element for this category.
master.grade_wage_taken: This gazette already fixes a wage for this category and grade.
master.holiday_taken: There is already a holiday with this code.
master.holiday_outside_year: The start date must fall inside the fiscal year.
master.holiday_on_calendar: This holiday has put days on the calendar — deactivate it instead.
master.festival_year: The year must be the festival date’s year.
master.festival_taken: This festival is already on the calendar for that year.
master.festival_no_year: No fiscal year holds that date, so its holiday cannot be filed — add the year first.
master.period_order: End Date cannot be before Start Date.
master.period_closed: This pay period is closed; nothing more is entered against it.
master.period_step: :period moves one step at a time — it cannot go from :from to :to.
master.deduction_taken: :employee already has this head deducted in this period.
master.row_bad_amount: The amount must be a number above zero.
master.row_bad_head: No pay element has this code.
master.file_format: The file is not :format — pick the file type that matches it.
master.file_unreadable: The file could not be read as a list of rows.
master.gazette_taken: There is already a gazette with this name.
master.gazette_in_use: Structure lines or grade wages are filed under this gazette — remove them first, or untick Active.
master.rewriting: Rewriting :name. Save to keep the changes, or cancel to leave it as it was.
master.not_under_node: That type is not filed under this node.
master.row_bad_period: No open pay period has this number.
master.row_deducted: This head is already deducted from this employee for this period.
master.row_entered: This element is already entered for this employee in this period.
master.period_move: ":move" cannot be done on :period — it is :status.
master.fy_in_use: :year has pay periods or holidays filed under it and is kept.
master.holiday_no_date: A holiday without a start date cannot go on the calendar.
master.holiday_inactive: An inactive holiday does not go on the calendar.

descriptions.employee-quick-registration: Register an employee with basic and salary information; assignment can follow now or later.
descriptions.employee-register: Every employee, searchable, with assignment status and actions.
descriptions.employee-assignment: Assign factory, building, floor, department, section, line, designation, grade and shift; manpower updates as you save.
descriptions.employee-profile: An employee's full record: personal, job, salary and history.
descriptions.biometric-fingerprint: Device setup, fingerprint registration, employee mapping and each employee's biometric status.
descriptions.daily-attendance: The day's attendance from the punches: IN, OUT, working hours, late, early out and OT.
descriptions.biometric-sync: Pull punches from the attendance terminals and see each device's last sync.
descriptions.missing-punch: Days with an IN or OUT punch missing, and their correction for approval.
descriptions.attendance-correction: One employee's whole month on one chart: correct status, IN, OUT, late and OT, enter past days, delete a day.
descriptions.monthly-attendance-summary: The month-end job card summary by department or section: daily attendance and OT, present, leave and total OT per worker.
descriptions.shift-roster: Put an employee, several employees or a whole line on a shift, or on a weekly rotation, with weekly off.
descriptions.ot-correction: OT is paid automatically from attendance; correct a day's OT hours or rate here, with a reason and full history.
descriptions.ot-eligibility: Who earns OT: general OT for graded workers, Worker OT switched on for staff, and the OT limits per day.
descriptions.ot-request: Request OT for a section and line — select all of the line or pick employees — with the OT window and reason.
descriptions.ot-approval: Approve, reject or return OT requests, directly or from your approval inbox.
descriptions.daily-salary: Attendance-based pay for a day: daily rate, allowance and OT, less late and other deduction.
descriptions.ot-salary: Automatic OT from attendance after the shift end, its rate and amount, with corrections applied.
descriptions.festival-bonus: The festival bonus for the month's festival, by eligibility and bonus rule.
descriptions.monthly-salary: Load, calculate, review, approve and finalize the month's payroll, then payslips and bank/cash payment.
descriptions.payroll-adjustment: Correct a finalized month without rewriting it: raise the difference, approve it, and pay it with the next salary.
descriptions.employee-transfer: Move an employee to another department, section or line; manpower follows.
descriptions.employee-promotion: Old designation and grade to new, approved before it takes effect.
descriptions.employee-increment: A raise in Gross A, approved before it takes effect.
descriptions.employee-re-join: Re-activate a former employee's own record.
descriptions.employee-separation: Resignation, release or termination, approved before the employee leaves.
descriptions.final-settlement: A leaving employee's dues, deductions and final payable, approved and paid.
descriptions.lefty-management: Employees who left without notice: report, investigate, confirm or reject, reinstate — payroll eligibility follows the decision.
descriptions.letter-master: Letter types and their templates — subject, body, terms, signature — with employee fields and version control.
descriptions.generate-letter: Search by Employee Number, or pick a section, floor or all employees; preview, generate and print A4 letters.
descriptions.letter-history: Every letter issued, exactly as it was — view, print again or export.
descriptions.letter-reports: The letter register by type, department, section, floor, date and who generated it.
descriptions.hr-dashboard: Today's manpower, attendance, late, missing punch and OT across designations and lines, with pending approvals.
descriptions.hr-reports: Employee, manpower, attendance, OT, salary and HR reports — view, print, PDF and Excel.

rd.employee-master: Every recorded field of each employee: identity, placement, salary structure and contact.
rd.employee-list: Code, name, card, designation and placement of each employee.
rd.employee-assignment: Where each active employee is placed, and whether the assignment is still pending.
rd.joining: Employees who joined between two dates.
rd.employee-status: Employees by status — active, inactive, suspended or separated.
rd.employee-movement: Transfers, promotions, increments, re-joinings and separations in a date range.
rd.total-manpower: Active head count, assignment and the day's attendance at a glance.
rd.designation-manpower: Operator, Quality, Helper, Supervisor and Staff — total, present, absent and on leave.
rd.floor-manpower: Head count by floor, split by category, with the day's attendance.
rd.department-manpower: Head count by department, split by category, with the day's attendance.
rd.section-manpower: Head count by section, split by category, with the day's attendance.
rd.line-manpower: Head count by line with the day's attendance and approved OT.
rd.daily-attendance: Every employee's IN, OUT, hours, late and early-out minutes and status for one day.
rd.monthly-attendance: Per-employee totals for a month: present, absent, leave, late, missing punch and hours.
rd.absent: Active employees absent on a day, including those with no punch at all.
rd.late: Late arrivals after the shift's grace time, with late minutes.
rd.early-out: Employees who left before the shift ended, with early-out minutes.
rd.missing-punch: Days with an IN and no OUT, or an OUT and no IN.
rd.shift-attendance: Each shift's assigned head count, present, absent, leave, late and missing punch for a day.
rd.attendance-correction: Corrected IN/OUT punches with reason, requester, approver and status.
rd.daily-ot: Automatic OT for one day: in/out against the shift end, original and corrected hours, grade, rate, OT salary and correction status.
rd.employee-ot: Each employee's OT days, hours and amount over a date range.
rd.section-ot: OT employees, hours and amount by section over a date range.
rd.line-ot: OT employees, hours and amount by line over a date range.
rd.ot-salary-summary: Payable OT hours and OT pay by department over a date range.
rd.monthly-ot: Each employee's OT days, hours, OT salary and corrections for a month — the sum of Daily OT.
rd.ot-correction-history: Every OT correction and reset: hours, rate and amount before and after, reason, who and when.
rd.grade-ot: OT employees, OT days, hours and OT salary per grade for a day or a date range, staff Worker OT apart.
rd.daily-salary: Attendance-based daily salary: rate, allowance, OT, late and other deductions, net.
rd.employee-daily-salary: Each employee's daily salary summed over a date range.
rd.monthly-salary: Each employee's monthly salary slip for a pay period.
rd.salary-register: The pay period's slips with every allowance and deduction component.
rd.payslip: One employee's payslip for a pay period, component by component.
rd.salary-deduction: Late deduction, head-wise deductions and loan / advance recovery per slip.
rd.allowance: Allowances paid or entered for a pay period, by employee and allowance.
rd.bonus: Festival bonus lines: festival, basis and amount per employee.
rd.bank-salary-sheet: Net pay with each employee's salary bank account, for the bank advice.
rd.gross-a-salary: Main payroll on Gross A for a pay period: earned gross, OT, bonus, deductions, adjustment, net and payroll status.
rd.gross-b-salary: Gross B payroll from Complex Management, read-only: Basic, House Rent, allowances, attendance, OT, deduction and net.
rd.gross-ab-combined: Gross A and Gross B side by side per employee: grade, both grosses, OT salary, Net Payable A and Net B.
rd.payroll-adjustment: Adjustments to finalized slips raised in a date range: original, revised and adjustment, status, and the month paid in.
rd.leave: Leave applications overlapping a date range, with days applied and approved.
rd.leave-balance: Entitlement, taken, adjusted and balance per employee and leave type for a fiscal year.
rd.promotion-increment: Promotions and salary increments effective in a date range.
rd.transfer: Transfers effective in a date range, old placement to new.
rd.final-settlement: Final settlements with salary, OT and bonus due, encashment, deductions and final payable.
