inspection.rolls_required: Enter at least one roll for :item before completing this receipt.
inspection.roll_no_required: Every roll needs a roll number.
inspection.roll_no_duplicate: Roll number :roll_no is already in use.
inspection.cannot_cancel_pending_inspection: This receipt has rolls still under inspection; resolve them before cancelling.
inspection.roll_not_pending: This roll is not waiting on inspection (it is :status).
inspection.disposition_required: Choose Damaged or Returned for a rejected roll.
inspection.defect_wrong_family: :defect is not on the :family defect list for this fabric.
inspection.roll_entry_hint: One row per physical roll received — measurements can be refined at inspection.
inspection.split_hint: The pieces must add up to the roll exactly. A split that loses half a metre is a stock adjustment, and should be posted as one.
inspection.merge_hint: Only rolls of the same item, shade, lot and bin can be joined. The new roll costs the weighted average of what went into it.
inspection.cost_adjusted_hint: The landed cost arrived after this roll left the store. The figure is right now; reports before the correction were not.
inspection.roll_not_splittable: Roll :roll cannot be split while it is :status.
inspection.roll_not_mergeable: Roll :roll cannot be merged while it is :status.
inspection.split_needs_two: A split produces at least two rolls.
inspection.merge_needs_two: Merging needs at least two rolls.
inspection.split_must_balance: The pieces come to :children but the roll is :parent.
inspection.merge_mismatch: The rolls do not share the same :field.
inspection.duplicate_roll_no: Roll number :roll_no is already in use.
inspection.claim_moved_to_children: Released when roll :roll was split; the hold moved to its pieces.
inspection.four_point_hint: Points per 100 square yards: total points × 36 × 100 ÷ (inspected yards × width). A lot's figure pools every inspected roll rather than averaging their percentages, so a short roll cannot outweigh a long one.
inspection.escalation_hint: The first pass covers a sample. Failing it opens a wider one; failing that opens the whole lot, or it goes back to the supplier.
inspection.defect_tally_hint: A fault scores on its length, not its kind — so the same defect can appear on one roll at several point classes. A hole is four points whatever its size.
inspection.width_hint: Measured at three places: a mill's width drifts along the roll, and the marker has to be laid to the narrowest point. The score uses the mean.
inspection.shade_hint: Checked under each light source, because a roll can match in daylight and go green under the store's tubes.
inspection.inspection_approved: :number accepted — rolls are on the shelf.
inspection.no_inspections: No fabric inspection has been recorded.
inspection.inspection_search_placeholder: Search by inspection number, style or buyer…
inspection.no_photos: No photo has been attached yet.
inspection.sheet_not_open: This sheet is :status, so nothing more can be tallied onto it.
inspection.bad_transition: An inspection cannot go from :from to :to.
inspection.nothing_inspected: No roll has been tallied onto this sheet yet.
inspection.roll_not_on_receipt: Roll :roll was not delivered on this receipt.
inspection.length_required: Enter the inspected length for roll :roll — a roll with no measured length has not been inspected.
inspection.width_required: Enter at least one width for roll :roll; the score cannot be computed without it.
inspection.bad_point_class: Every defect on roll :roll needs a point class of 1, 2, 3 or 4.
inspection.defect_not_in_family: That defect is not on the :family list for this fabric.
inspection.escalate_needs_a_failure: Only a rejected pass escalates to a wider one.
inspection.escalation_exhausted: The whole lot has already been inspected. What happens next is a commercial decision, not a wider sample.

inventory.uom_unknown: Pick :uom from the units of measure (Settings → Master Data), or add it there first.
inventory.issue_return_intro: Consumables leaving the store without a work order: a box of gloves to the dye house, a roll of tape to the sewing floor.
inventory.issue_no_asset_warning: Nothing issued here is charged to a machine. Anything fitted to one should go through its work order instead, which is where the cost belongs and where the failure history can find it.
inventory.who_and_why: Who took it, and what for
inventory.no_direct_movements: Nothing issued outside a work order.
inventory.no_direct_movements_hint: Parts fitted to machines appear on their work orders instead.
inventory.no_compatibility: Nothing recorded. The store cannot tell what this part fits, or what will do instead.
inventory.substitutes_for: This part will do instead of
inventory.compatibility_already_listed: That model is already listed for this part.
inventory.cannot_substitute_itself: A part cannot stand in for itself.
inventory.unknown_asset_model: That model is not available to your company.
inventory.unknown_part: That part is not available to your company.
inventory.transfers_intro: Moving stock between factories. One factory asks, someone approves, the sending store dispatches, the receiving store confirms — and in between the stock is in neither, so a valuation taken while the van is on the road still balances.
inventory.awaiting_receipt: Waiting for the receiving factory to confirm.
inventory.request_a_part: Ask the store for a part
inventory.request_hint: This asks the store for the part. It moves no stock and reserves nothing — the store decides whether to issue it or order it.
inventory.cannot_cancel_issued: Parts have already been issued against this line, so the request cannot be withdrawn. Return what is not needed instead.
inventory.part_requests_intro: Every part asked for on an open job and not yet handed over, with what is on the shelf beside it. A stopped machine comes first, then the longest wait.
inventory.no_part_requests: Nothing is waiting on the store.
inventory.no_part_requests_hint: Requests made by technicians on open work orders appear here.
inventory.delete_confirm: Remove :number? Only a part nothing is filed against can be removed; one that has stock or history must be retired instead.
inventory.delete_blocked: :count records point at this part — stock movements, reservations or work order lines — so it cannot be removed. Retire it instead, which keeps the ledger readable.
inventory.deactivate_hint: A retired part disappears from every picker but keeps its stock ledger, so what was fitted to a machine two years ago still reads correctly. Parts are never deleted.
inventory.unknown_category: That category is not available to your company.
inventory.unknown_manufacturer: That manufacturer is not available to your company.
inventory.unknown_uom: That unit is not available to your company.
inventory.no_opening_quantity_hint: No opening quantity here — stock enters through the ledger, so every unit has a movement behind it.
inventory.spare_parts_page_description: The catalogue of every part the stores carry.
inventory.name: Name
inventory.no_parts_hint: Add the parts this factory keeps in store.
inventory.try_different_filter: Try a different search or filter.
inventory.reorder_hint: Below the reorder level is the useful signal, not below zero. By the time stock is out, the lead time has already been lost.
inventory.threshold_note: Thresholds are policy. Quantities come from the ledger and are never typed in.
inventory.unit_cost_hint: Reference only. An issue is always costed at the weighted average in the ledger.
inventory.critical_hint: A part whose absence stops a critical machine.
inventory.available_hint: On hand minus what is already promised to somebody else's work order.
inventory.no_stock_hint: Receive stock into a bin to start the ledger.
inventory.low_stock_page_description: At or below the reorder level. Critical spares — an absence that stops a critical machine — lead the list.
inventory.stock_page_description: What's on the shelf right now, bin by bin.
inventory.ledger_hint: Append-only. A correction is a reversal row, never an edit, so the history shows both what was recorded and what was done about it.
inventory.reverse_confirm_desc: Posts an opposing row — the original stays exactly as it was.
inventory.already_reversed: That movement has already been reversed.
inventory.ledger_matches: {1} Ledger replays to the stored balance (1 movement).|[2,*] Ledger replays to the stored balance (:count movements).
inventory.ledger_mismatch: Ledger replays to :replayed but the balance says :balance. A movement was written outside the ledger.
inventory.adjust_stock_hint: A physical-count correction. Stock that moves without an explanation is indistinguishable from loss.
inventory.notes_no_work_order_hint: Stock moving with no work order behind it is indistinguishable from loss without one.
inventory.quantity_must_be_positive: The quantity must be greater than zero.
inventory.insufficient_stock: Only :available of :part are available, and :requested were asked for.
inventory.adjustment_needs_reason: An adjustment needs a reason. Stock that moves without one is indistinguishable from loss.
inventory.reserve_after_close: A closed work order cannot reserve stock.
inventory.parts_after_close: A closed work order no longer accepts parts.
inventory.reservation_not_holding: That reservation is no longer holding stock.
inventory.release_exceeds_reservation: That is more than the reservation still holds.
inventory.issue_exceeds_reservation: That is more than the reservation still holds.
inventory.consume_exceeds_issued: Only :outstanding are still out of the store against this line.
inventory.return_exceeds_issued: Only :outstanding are still out of the store against this line.
inventory.negative_stock_allowed: This factory allows negative stock, so the issue was posted anyway.
inventory.outstanding_hint: Taken from the store but neither fitted nor returned. A work order cannot close while this is above zero.
inventory.substitute_hint: Recorded, because fitting a different part than the one specified is what a failure analysis needs to know later.
inventory.no_parts_on_work_order: No parts on this work order.
inventory.no_transfers_hint: Stock moving between factories appears here.
inventory.transfer_invalid_transition: A transfer cannot move from :from to :to.
inventory.transfer_needs_items: A transfer needs at least one part.
inventory.transfer_same_factory: A transfer needs two different factories.
inventory.transfer_needs_in_transit_bin: The source factory has no in-transit bin, so dispatched stock would have nowhere to sit.
inventory.in_transit_hint: Dispatched stock sits in an in-transit bin until it is received, so it is never in two places and never nowhere.
inventory.variance_hint: Dispatched but not received. A non-zero variance is a discrepancy to investigate, not something to write off.
inventory.receive_exceeds_dispatched: More cannot be received than was dispatched.
inventory.receive_needs_destination: Choose the bin the stock is going into.
inventory.destination_bin_needed_hint: A destination bin is needed for each item before it can be received.

itemmaster.page_description: Everything the factory buys, stocks or issues, in one list. A requisition or purchase order picks from here — it never invents an item.
itemmaster.library_hint: Not in the list? Ask an admin to add it. Items are never typed into a transaction.
itemmaster.retire_hint: A retired item disappears from every picker but stays on every document that named it.
itemmaster.delete_confirm: Remove :code? Only an item nothing points at can be removed; one on a receipt must be retired instead.
itemmaster.delete_blocked: :count records point at this item, so it cannot be removed. Retire it instead.
itemmaster.no_items_hint: Add the first item, or import the legacy library.
itemmaster.try_different_filter: Try a different search or filter.
itemmaster.name: Name
itemmaster.item_type_hint: Filled in from the department; change it if this item is something else.
itemmaster.purchase_uom_hint: Only when it differs from the stock unit — bought by the yard, stocked by the metre.
itemmaster.reorder_hint: Below the reorder level is the useful signal, not below zero.
itemmaster.returnable_hint: A tool or gauge that comes back to the store after use, not a consumable.
itemmaster.fabric_spec_hint: GSM, width and composition are required for a fabric: a roll cannot be inspected without them.
itemmaster.yarn_spec_hint: Count and fibre are required for a yarn.
itemmaster.unknown_category: That category is not available to your company.
itemmaster.unknown_department: That department is not available to your company.
itemmaster.unknown_store: That store is not available to your company.
itemmaster.unknown_hs_code: That HS code is not available to your company.
itemmaster.unknown_uom: That unit is not available to your company.
itemmaster.unknown_vendor: That supplier is not available to your company.
itemmaster.unknown_manufacturer: That manufacturer is not available to your company.
itemmaster.category_not_under_parent: That category does not sit under the one chosen above it.
itemmaster.spec_required: :field is required for this item type.
itemmaster.no_stock_yet: Nothing has been received against this item yet.
itemmaster.low_stock_intro: Items whose stock has reached their reorder level, emptiest first. Raise a purchase requisition before the lead time is gone.
itemmaster.no_low_stock: Nothing is below its reorder level.
itemmaster.lot_required: :item is lot-tracked; a lot number is required to receive it.
itemmaster.roll_ledger_not_available: :item is roll-tracked (fabric); roll receiving arrives in Phase 2.
itemmaster.insufficient_stock: Only :available of :item are available, and :requested were asked for.
itemmaster.lots_hint: Nearest expiry first, then oldest received. An expired lot stays listed so somebody can decide to scrap it.
itemmaster.no_reservations: Nothing is being held against this item.
itemmaster.earmark_hint: A claim on stock that has not arrived yet. It holds nothing until the goods receipt lands.
itemmaster.insufficient_available: Only :available of :item are free; the rest is already held for somebody else.
itemmaster.reserve_roll_by_roll: :item is roll-tracked; reserve it by naming a roll, not a quantity.
itemmaster.roll_not_reservable: Roll :roll cannot be held while it is :status.
itemmaster.issue_exceeds_reservation: That is more than the reservation still holds.
itemmaster.release_exceeds_reservation: That is more than the reservation still holds.
itemmaster.count_hint: The system quantities are frozen the moment the sheet is generated, so a receipt posted while the aisles are being walked stays a receipt instead of becoming a variance. The adjustment moves the difference, never the whole balance.
itemmaster.blind_count_hint: The counter does not see what the system expects. Showing it is how a count becomes a formality — the easiest thing in the world is to write down the number already printed next to the box.
itemmaster.record_found_hint: Stock the system has no row for at all. Without somewhere to write this down a count can only ever find the discrepancies the system already half knew about.
itemmaster.post_count_hint: Writes one stock adjustment per variance line, at the value the stock held when the sheet was frozen. It cannot be undone — a mistake is corrected by a second count.
itemmaster.no_counts: No stock count has been run yet.
itemmaster.count_already_open: Count :number is already open over this store. Two counts would each freeze a different figure.
itemmaster.cycle_count_needs_scope: A cycle count needs a scope — a department, a category, some bins or some items. Without one it is a full stock take under the wrong name.
itemmaster.count_nothing_to_count: Nothing on these shelves to count.
itemmaster.count_not_open: A :status count takes no more entries.
itemmaster.count_not_postable: A :status count has no adjustment to post.
itemmaster.count_unknown_line: That line is not on this count sheet.
itemmaster.count_qty_not_negative: A counted quantity cannot be negative — an empty shelf is zero.
itemmaster.count_has_uncounted: :count shelf/shelves have not been counted. Closing now would write off whatever nobody reached.
itemmaster.count_bin_outside_store: That bin is not in the store being counted.
itemmaster.count_item_not_countable: :item is tracked piece by piece, so it is reconciled against the roll register rather than counted as a quantity.

descriptions.user-company-office-mapping: Which company and which office each user may raise knitting entries against.
descriptions.machine-capacity-hour-plan: Declared hourly capacity per machine, and the plan the loading is built on.
descriptions.machine-profile: Gauge, diameter, feeder count and make of every knitting machine on the floor.
descriptions.assign-machine-operator: The operator posted to each machine, shift by shift.
descriptions.yarn-count-setup: Counts, blends and compositions every yarn record is built from.
descriptions.label-printer-setup: Printers and label formats used for roll and batch tags.
descriptions.sc-party-rate: Sub-contract knitting rates agreed per party, per fabric construction.

offices.hint: Pick a user, tick the company-and-office pairs they may work against, and save. A user with nothing ticked is unrestricted — the moment one pair is ticked they are confined to what is ticked.
offices.empty_title: Choose a user from the list
offices.empty: The full list of offices loads once a user is picked, with everything mapped today already ticked.
offices.no_offices: Add factories on Company Management first.
offices.footer: :selected of :count offices selected. Save writes the grid as it stands: pairs ticked since it loaded are granted, pairs unticked are revoked, and nothing else is touched.

capacity.hint: Bands do not overlap: one machine has one plan for any given day. Close the current band, or start the new one the day after it ends.
capacity.schedule_hint: Leave blank where the band applies whatever pattern the floor is running.
capacity.to_hint: Blank means the band is open-ended — the plan in force until another starts.
capacity.capacity_hint: Kilograms the machine gives in one running hour at 100%.

machine.hint: A machine is withdrawn rather than deleted once anything names it: clear Active?, and the record stays readable for whatever was knitted on it.
machine.no_hint: As it is painted on the machine — the whole floor calls it by this.
machine.country_hint: Where the machine was built, not who supplied it.
machine.gauge_hint: The gauge the machine is set to today. It must be one of the supported gauges below.
machine.supported_hint: Every gauge this cylinder can be re-needled to. Planning reads it to know whether a job could be moved here.

lists.intro: The four lists the machine form selects from — the kinds of machine, the makes, the cylinder diameters and the gauges. Pick a list to edit it, or add to it.
lists.empty: Its entries load beside it, and nothing is read from the database until you do.
lists.no_entries: Add the first one with Add entry above, then Save.
lists.footer: :count entries. An entry in use cannot be deleted — clear Active? instead, which withholds it from new machines while the ones already filed under it keep it. The Machines column counts everything pointing at the entry, a supported gauge included.

operator.hint: One live operator per machine per schedule. A posting that overlaps one already on file is refused — two answers to "who was running it" is the same as none.
operator.effective_hint: A time as well as a day: a night shift handed over at 22:40 is not the same fact as one handed over that morning.
operator.until_hint: Leave blank for the standing posting. Dating the next posting is what ends this one.
operator.machine_hint: Pick a machine to see who has been posted to it. Close a posting by dating it, or withdraw one raised in error — a change of operator is a new posting, not an edit to the last one.
operator.empty: Its postings load beside it, and nothing is read from the database until you do.
operator.no_postings: Post an operator on the New Assign tab.
operator.footer: :count postings. Date Until to close a posting; remove a line to withdraw a posting raised in error.

yarn.hint: A count in use is withdrawn rather than deleted: clear Active?, and every yarn already described by it stays readable.
yarn.no_hint: As the floor writes it. This is what the store's bin cards and the spinner's invoice both print.
yarn.desc_hint: The description printed wherever the count appears in a sentence.
yarn.value_hint: The count as a number, so counts can be sorted and banded. Blank where the figure is genuinely not known.
yarn.single_hint: Clear it for a plied yarn. A 30/2 is two 30s twisted together and knits nothing like a 30/1.

printer.hint: A printer with no users listed is offered to everyone. List one and it is offered only to those listed.
printer.name_hint: What the floor calls it. This is the name that appears in the print dialog.
printer.address_hint: The queue name or share the print client sends to. Nothing on the server opens it.
printer.users_hint: Tick the users this printer is offered to. None ticked offers it to everyone.
printer.auto_hint: Tick where the driver scales the label to the stock rather than printing at the design's own size.

master.machine_taken: There is already a machine with this number.
master.gauge_not_supported: The gauge must be one of the supported gauges.
master.to_before_from: Effective To cannot be before Effective From.
master.band_overlaps: This band overlaps one already on file for the machine. Close the current band, or start the new one the day after it ends.
master.posting_overlaps: This posting overlaps one already on file for the machine and schedule.
master.count_taken: There is already a count with this number.
master.printer_taken: There is already a printer with this name.
master.entry_in_use: An entry in use cannot be deleted — clear Active? instead.
master.one_primary: Only one office can be primary.

descriptions.yarn-purchase-requisition: Yarn raised against a booking, before it is turned into a purchase order.
descriptions.yr-pr-approve-list: Requisitions waiting on approval, and who each one is sitting with.
descriptions.comparative-statement: Supplier quotations set side by side before the order is placed.
descriptions.yarn-purchase-order: The placed order — count, quantity, rate and delivery schedule.

yarn.nothing: No records to choose from yet.

yr.list_hint: Nothing filled in lists the most recent requisitions. Add New opens the entry desk, where the yarn being asked for is written line by line.
yr.empty: No requisition matches. Press Add New to raise one, or widen the search above.
yr.entry_hint: The yarn an order needs, split into what will be bought locally and what will be imported. Submitting it from the register is what sends it for approval.
yr.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
yr.no_hint: The requisition number is issued when the form is first saved.
yr.store_hint: Where the yarn is to be received. The store the purchase order and the receipt will both quote.
yr.required_hint: When the floor wants the yarn. The date the approve list is worked in order of.
yr.lines_hint: One line per yarn item. Split the quantity between what will be bought locally and what will be imported — the total is their sum and is worked out for you.
yr.no_lines_hint: A requisition with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
yr.foot: The requisition number is issued on save. A draft is rewritable; once it has been submitted for approval this form refuses it.

ap.title: YR/PR Approve List
ap.hint: Only requisitions waiting on a decision are listed. Approving one makes it orderable; rejecting it sends it back to the desk that raised it.
ap.note_hint: Carried onto whichever requisitions are approved or rejected next. A rejection with no reason is one nobody can answer.

cs.list_title: Comparison of Price Quatation for Purchase Order
cs.list_hint: Nothing filled in lists the most recent comparisons. Add New opens the comparison desk, where the requisition is picked and the spinners' offers are entered against its lines.
cs.empty: No comparison matches. Press Add New to raise one against an approved requisition.
cs.desk_hint: Lay the spinners' quotations against an approved requisition, line by line, and record which of them each line is being bought from.
cs.no_hint: The comparison number is issued when the sheet is first saved.
cs.requisition_hint: Approved requisitions only. Picking one from the list beside the form also fills the grid with its lines, their present stock and their open pipeline.
cs.req_date_hint: Copied from the requisition when the sheet is saved, so a comparison read months later still shows the paper it was raised from.
cs.details_hint: One row per yarn item. SL # is what the offers below are quoted against — leave it blank and the next free number is used. Total, and the quantity actually worth ordering, are worked out as the figures beside them are typed. Copy a row to split one item across two sources or two shipments.
cs.no_lines_hint: A comparison with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
cs.offers_hint: One row per spinner per line — the printed sheet's + button. SL # is the serial of the Details Data row the price is quoted against; Source says which of the two printed price bands it belongs to. A spinner quoting both local and import against one line is two rows.
cs.no_offers: No offer has been recorded yet. A comparison with no prices on it compares nothing, so at least one is needed before the sheet can be finalized.
cs.foot: The comparison number is issued on save. Finalising it — from the list — is what fixes which spinner each line is bought from, and a finalized sheet no longer takes edits.

po.list_hint: Nothing filled in lists the most recent orders. Add New opens the order desk, which is raised off a finalized comparison or straight against an approved requisition.
po.yr_hint: Matched against every requisition the order answers, not only the first.
po.empty: No purchase order matches. Press Add New to raise one, or widen the search above.
po.entry_hint: The order placed on a spinner — what is being bought, at what price, on what terms and against which requisition. Placing it from the list is what makes it receivable at the gate.
po.no_hint: The order number is issued when the form is first saved.
po.store_hint: Where the yarn is to be received. The store the gate will check the delivery into.
po.cs_hint: The finalized comparison this order comes off. Picking one from the list beside the form brings its lines across at the price they were agreed at.
po.yr_hint2: The requisition this order answers. Filled from the comparison when there is one; asked for here when the order is typed straight against a requisition.
po.conv_hint: To the ledger's own money, as at the day the order is placed. Held on the order so a rate that moves afterwards cannot restate it.
po.lines_hint: One line per yarn item bought. The amount is quantity times rate and settles as the two are typed; the store keeps the received column in step from its own receipts.
po.no_lines_hint: A purchase order with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
po.foot: The order number is issued on save. A draft is rewritable; once it has been placed on the supplier this form refuses it, because the store is receiving against those lines.

v.no_lines: A requisition that asks for no yarn asks for nothing.
v.line_yarn: Line :n names no yarn — pick its Yarn Item or Count.
v.line_qty: Line :n asks for no yarn — fill Local or Import.
v.locked: This requisition is :status — only a draft or one sent back is changed.
v.reject_note: A rejection with no reason is one nobody can answer.
v.cs_no_lines: A comparison with no yarn on it compares nothing.
v.sl_twice: Two lines carry the same SL #.
v.offer_sl: An offer is quoted against SL # :sl, which no line carries.
v.no_offers: A comparison with no prices on it compares nothing — record at least one offer before finalizing.
v.unfinalized: Pick the spinner each line is bought from before finalizing (SL # :sl).
v.cs_locked: :no is :status — a finalized or cancelled sheet takes no edits.
v.po_no_lines: A purchase order that buys nothing orders nothing.
v.po_line_qty: Line :n buys no yarn — fill its Qty.

req_type.FIN_FAB_SAMPLE: Fin Fab Req by Sample Section
req_type.GREY_FAB_BULK_BATCH: Grey Fab Req for Bulk Batch
req_type.GREY_FAB_SAMPLE_BATCH: Grey Fab Req for Sample Batch
req_type.DYED_YARN_SC_KNIT: Req for Dyed Yarn for S/C Knitting (Out-House)
req_type.GREY_FAB_SC_PROGRAM: Req for Grey Fab Req for S/C Program
req_type.SOLID_YARN_SC_KNIT_BULK: Req for Solid Yarn for S/C Knitting (Out-House) - Bulk
req_type.LOAN_RETURN_FROM_PARTY: Requisition for Loan Return from Party
req_type.LOAN_RETURN_TO_PARTY: Requisition for Loan Return to Party
req_type.KNIT_MC_OIL: Store Requisition for Knit M/C Oil
req_type.COLLAR_CUFF_BULK: Yarn Requisition For Collar and/or Cuff (Bulk)

ret_done.accept: :no accepted — the counted weight is back in stock.

pc_done.issue: :no issued — the yarn is off the store.
pc_done.reject: :no rejected — the yarn is back in stock.

rp_done.submit: :no submitted — the consignment is off the store.

ir.list_hint: Balance Qty is TTL Req. Qty − TTL Issue Qty. A requisition can be marked closed before it is fully issued — that is a decision, not an arithmetic result.
ir.empty: No yarn requisition matches that search
ir.entry_hint: What the floor is asking the store for. Each line is one count against one programme; KP Alloc is what the programme has reserved but not yet drawn.
ir.program_hint: Type the knit programme number to link this yarn to it. Linked yarn is what the process-loss and cost-per-kg reports set against the rolls knitted.
ir.lines_hint: Req. Qty is what is being asked for. KP Alloc is what the programme has already reserved against the store's stock — it is subtracted from the month's closing balance whether or not it has been drawn.
ir.no_lines_hint: A requisition with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
ir.foot: A requisition with yarn already issued against it cannot have its lines rewritten — issue the balance, or close it and raise a new one.

is.entry_hint: Issue yarn off the store against one requisition. Each line names the requisition line it answers, and the balance owed on that line comes down as it is saved.
is.req_hint: Only requisitions still open are offered. The company and store come from the requisition.
is.lines_hint: One line per requisition line answered. The lot is what actually left the rack, which is why it is typed here and not copied off the requisition.
is.no_lines_hint: A issue with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
is.foot: An issue cannot take a requisition line past what it asked for. Correcting an over-issue is a return, not an edit.
is.saved: :no saved — the yarn is off the store.
is.credited: yarn has come back against it

irr.empty: No yarn has been returned to the store yet.
irr.entry_hint: Unused yarn coming back off the floor. Ret is what was sent; Recv is what the store counted in — the two differ more often than anybody expects.
irr.lines_hint: Naming the issue line the yarn left on is what lets the store credit it. A line with no issue behind it is accepted, but it credits nothing and shows as an unmatched return.
irr.foot: Accepting the challan is done on the register — that is the moment the counted weight goes back into stock and the issue behind it is credited.

pw.empty: No yarn issue challan has been raised yet.
pw.entry_hint: Yarn going out of the store to a sub-contract party. The gate pass is written by security when the lorry leaves, so it stays blank until it does.
pw.lines_hint: One line per stock line leaving. The lot matters: what goes out on this paper is what the racking board stops counting as available.
pw.foot: A cancelled challan stays on file. The answer to a wrong one is a cancellation on the register, not a deletion here.

rp.empty: No yarn has gone back to a spinner yet.
rp.entry_hint: The consignment going back to a spinner against a replacement claim. One line per lot on the lorry.
rp.claim_hint: The replacement claim this consignment answers. Left blank for yarn going back ahead of the paperwork.
rp.lc_no_hint: The credit the lot came in under, when it was imported.
rp.lot_hint: The lot the consignment is against — what the register prints and what the spinner will quote back.
rp.lines_hint: One line per lot leaving the store. Cartons are what the gate counts; the weight is what the claim is settled on. The lot number is upper-cased, so two spellings of one lot cannot both exist on the paper.
rp.foot: Saving writes the challan as a draft. Submit and Accept are on the register — Accepted is the spinner's signature coming back, and it is what settles the claim behind the challan.

descriptions.issue-against-requisition: Yarn issued to a knitting program against an approved requisition.
descriptions.issue-return-against-requisition: Unused yarn returned to the store against the issue it left on.
descriptions.party-wise-yarn-issue-challan: Yarn issued out to a sub-contract party, party by party.
descriptions.issue-yarn-replace-by-supplier-list: Yarn the supplier is replacing, and what went out against it.
descriptions.yarn-opening: The yarn stock a new period opens with.
descriptions.process-loss-adjustment-yd: Dyeing process loss written off against the yarn issued.
descriptions.knitting-yd-statement: Yarn-dyed movement for the period, issue against receive.
descriptions.yarn-receive-challan-sc-in-house: Yarn received for in-house sub-contract knitting, on challan.
descriptions.dyed-yarn-receive-in-house: Dyed yarn coming back from the in-house dye house.
descriptions.yd-reprocess-in-house-to-yd-factory: Off-shade yarn sent back out of in-house stock for re-dyeing.
descriptions.yd-reprocess-sc-knitting-to-yd-factory: Yarn returned by a sub-contract knitter and routed on for re-dyeing.
descriptions.opening-balance: Store-wise opening balance per count, lot and shade.
descriptions.daily-receive: Yarn taken into the store today, against supplier challan.
descriptions.yarn-stock-racking-board: Rack and bin position of every lot held in the yarn store.
descriptions.daily-receive-return: Receipts reversed the same day — short, wet or off-count lots.
descriptions.yarn-month-closing: Locks the month's yarn movement and carries the balance forward.
descriptions.yarn-adjustment: Physical-count corrections booked against the yarn ledger.

tabs.pw_list: Party Wise Yarn Issue Challan List
tabs.pw_entry: Party Wise Yarn Issue Challan Entry
tabs.rp_list: Issue Yarn Replace by Supplier List

op.title: Yarn Opening & Colosing Operation
op.hint: One store, one month. Adjustment and Reason of Adj are the only cells typed — every other figure is struck from the movements themselves, on this grid and again when it is saved.
op.pick_title: Choose a company, a store and a month, then press Search.
op.pick: Fill in the panel above and press Search.
op.foot: Reset is the Search button — nothing is held between builds, so re-running the search restores what is stored.
op.store_first: Choose a company and a store. A yarn ledger without a store in it is every store's stock added together.
op.closed: This month is closed — the grid is read only.
op.finalized_note: Finalised — the month's grid is signed for this store.
op.done: The month is finalised for this store.

ob.list_hint: Nothing filled in loads the most recent lines. The store's whole opening balance runs to tens of thousands of them, so each box narrows the query itself.
ob.empty: No opening balance line matches that search
ob.empty_hint: Change the search above and load again.
ob.entry_hint: The stock the yarn store is declared to hold. Pick a header on the left to correct one, or fill in a new Company Data block and add its lines.
ob.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
ob.buyer_hint: Left blank for buffer stock, which is held against no particular order.
ob.lines_hint: One line per stock line — the yarn, whose brand, which lot. Total Qty is Pack Qty × Qty/Pack and TTL Value is Total Qty × Cost Price; both are worked out rather than typed.
ob.no_lines_hint: A opening balance with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
ob.foot: Finalising a balance is done from the register. Until then its lines can be corrected here; afterwards they are what the store signed for.
ob.done_finalize: :no finalised — its stock is on the ledger.

mrr.list_hint: Nothing filled in loads the most recent receipts. Every box narrows the query itself, so a supplier with twenty thousand MRRs is still one page.
mrr.empty: No yarn receipt matches that search
mrr.empty_hint: Change the search above and load again.
mrr.entry_hint: Raise an MRR against a supplier's delivery. Pick a receipt on the left to correct one that has not been finalised, or fill in a new header and add its lines.
mrr.po_hint: Read only when Recv. Opt. is Receive By PO, and required then.
mrr.pi_hint: Read only when Recv. Opt. is Receive By PI, and required then.
mrr.ref_hint: The paper the receipt quotes — the PI's or PO's own reference, or the supplier's when nothing was ordered.
mrr.lines_hint: One line per stock line taken in. Qty is what the store actually counted; Challan Qty is what the supplier's paper claimed, so a short delivery is visible rather than argued about later.
mrr.no_lines_hint: A receipt with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
mrr.foot: A receipt keeps its own number, issued on save. The four desk checks — store, audit and accounts — are taken on the register, not here.
mrr.no_pi: No proforma invoice is on record yet.

done.cancel: :no cancelled — its yarn is off the ledger.
done.return: Return challan :no raised — trim it and issue it.

ret.title: Returns & Exchanges
ret.hint: Yarn refused at the desk. Pick the challan on the left, trim each line to what is going back, and save it as issued.
ret.challan_hint: Returnable means security should expect the same cartons back through the gate.
ret.lines_hint: Trim each line to what is actually leaving. A line set to zero is dropped from the challan.
ret.no_lines_hint: A return challan with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
ret.foot: A challan is raised from the register's Return or Exchange button. There is nothing to create here — only to trim and issue.
ret.issued: :no issued — the yarn has gone back.
ret.list_hint: Dates are inclusive of both ends. Leave everything blank to see the most recent returns.
ret.empty: No return challan matches that search

rack.board_hint: Rack Pending is Recv + Trns Recv. − Trns Sent − Return − Racked. Yarn is put away on the Rack Assignment tab, a receipt line at a time.
rack.empty: No stock line matches that search
rack.empty_hint: Change the search above and load again.
rack.assign_hint: Put received yarn away. Pick the rack and the weight going on it; what is left stays pending and comes back on the next search.
rack.pick_title: Choose a store, then press Search.
rack.pick: Fill in the panel above and press Search.
rack.assign_foot: Leave Rack Qty blank on a row to put the whole pending weight away at once.
rack.pick_rows: Give at least one row a Rack#.

mc.title: Yarn Store Month Closing
mc.hint: Show Exception lists what would stop the close without changing anything. Month Close applies the same checks again and strikes the month if they pass.
mc.finished: A month is closed after it has finished.
mc.none: No month has been closed yet. Pick a finished month above and press Show Exception to see what is outstanding in it.
mc.empty_hint: Change the search above and load again.
mc.clear: :month has nothing outstanding — it can be closed.

ex.issue_return: Not accepted — accept, reject or cancel it.
ex.party: Still a draft — issue or cancel it.
ex.replace: Still a draft — submit or cancel it.
ex.unfinished: The month has not finished yet.
ex.mrr: Still at Store Receive — verify or cancel it.
ex.ob: Not finalised — finalise it or remove it.
ex.return: Not issued — issue it or delete it.
ex.grid: The store moved yarn this month but its Yarn Opening Entry grid is not finalised.

adj.list_hint: Every correction booked against the ledger; a cancelled one has come back off it.
adj.entry_hint: Correct the ledger to what was physically counted: each lot up (+) or down (−). A lot never goes below what it holds.
adj.reason_hint: Why the count differs — it is printed on the adjustment.
adj.lines_hint: Pick the lot from the store's stock; Adjust Qty is the difference, positive to add, negative to take off.
adj.no_lines_hint: An adjustment with no lines corrects nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.

v.req_locked: :no has yarn issued against it — its lines cannot be rewritten.
v.req_no_lines: A requisition with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.issue_returned: :no has yarn returned against it — correct it with a return, not an edit.
v.issue_req: Pick a requisition that is still open.
v.issue_no_lines: A issue with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.issue_line: Every line needs its Requisition Line.
v.issue_lot_pick: Every line needs the lot it leaves from.
v.issue_lot: Line :n names a lot not held in this store.
v.issue_lot_match: Line :n's lot is not the yarn its requisition line asks for.
v.issue_over: Line :n takes the requisition line past what it asked for (:left left).
v.issue_stock: Line :n takes more than the lot holds (:left).
v.ret_no_lines: A return challan with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.ret_issue_line: Line :n names an issue line not on the requisition.
v.ret_over: Line :n brings back more than went out on its issue line (:left).
v.pc_no_lines: A issue challan with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.rp_no_lines: A challan with no yarn on it sends the spinner an empty lorry.
v.rp_lot_supplier: Line :n's lot came from another supplier.
v.month_closed: :period is closed — its yarn movement is locked.
v.store_and_company: Choose a company and a store. A yarn ledger without a store in it is every store's stock added together.
v.line_qty: Line :n takes no yarn — fill its quantity.
v.ob_no_lines: A opening balance with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.ob_finalized: :no is finalised — its lines are what the store signed for.
v.no_pi: No proforma invoice is on record yet — receive by PO or direct.
v.mrr_no_lines: A receipt with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.po_line: Line :n is not on the purchase order.
v.over_po: Line :n receives more than the order still owes (:left).
v.receipt_cancelled: A cancelled receipt has nothing to send back.
v.return_line: That line is not on the receipt.
v.return_more: Line :n sends back more than is held on it (:left).
v.return_stock: Line :n sends back more than the lot still holds (:left).
v.return_no_lines: A return challan with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.return_issued: :no is issued — it can no longer change.
v.adj_no_lines: An adjustment with no lines corrects nothing.
v.adj_qty: Every line needs a non-zero Adjust Qty.
v.adj_lot: Line :n names a lot not held in this store.
v.adj_below: Line :n takes off more than the lot holds (:left).
v.rack_more: Row :n racks more than is pending (:left).
v.period_reason: Row :n has an adjustment without its Reason of Adj.
v.period_finalized: The month is finalised for this store — the grid is read only.
v.has_exceptions: :count exception(s) stop the close — press Show Exception to see them.

descriptions.fabric-production-order-bulk: The bulk knitting order a style's fabric is produced against.
descriptions.collar-cuff-production: Collar and cuff output from the flat-bed machines.
descriptions.knitting-reports: The module's report set — production, efficiency, yarn and grey movement.
descriptions.yarn-current-stock: Yarn on hand right now, by count, lot, shade and store.
descriptions.fabric-current-stock: Grey fabric on hand right now, by order, construction and store.

qc.v_count: Count is needed before the row can be added.

qc.clean: No defect found — a clean roll.

approve.title: Approve this programme?
approve.body: Approving releases the programme to the party. Nothing on it can be rewritten afterwards.

reject.title: Reject this programme?
reject.body: It goes back to the desk to be put right and submitted again.

delete.title: Delete this programme?
delete.body: A draft that was never submitted is thrown away; nothing else names it.

confirm.title: Confirm this programme?
confirm.body: The programme is answered: the fabric lines are fixed and the floor may plan against them.

start.title: Start production?

close.title: Close this programme?
close.body: Nothing more is knitted against it.

cancel.title: Cancel this programme?
cancel.body: It stays on the register as cancelled.

hint.existing: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
hint.store: The store the single yarn leaves from, and the twisted yarn comes back to.
hint.lines: Grey(Kg) is the single yarn going out. What comes back is written by the Twist Yarn Receive tab and is not typed here.
hint.program_foot: The programme number is issued on save. A programme that already has receives against it cannot have its yarn lines rewritten — what the party was sent is what they were sent.
hint.program_locked: :no has receives against it — its yarn lines are what the party was sent.
hint.list: Yarn twisting programmes placed with outside twisters, with what each is owed back
hint.receive_form: Twisted yarn coming back from the party. Grey(Kg) is what the line accounts for and Receive(Kg) is what actually arrived — the difference is the twisting loss, which is what the bill is argued over.
hint.gate_pass: Written by security when the lorry arrives. Left blank until it does.
hint.finalized: Fixes the weights so a bill may be raised on them. A finalised challan cannot have its lines rewritten.
hint.transferred: The twisted yarn has been taken onto the store's own stock. A separate decision from finalising, and usually a later one.
hint.receive_locked: :no is finalised — only Transfer? can still be set.
hint.receive_lines: Pick the programme line each lot comes back against; Grey(Kg) can never come to more than that line sent out.
hint.bill_form: What the twister is owed. Each line prices one finalised receive challan; a line with no challan behind it is an agreed adjustment and has to say so in its particulars.
hint.party_bill: The twister's own invoice reference, which is not ours.
hint.bill_foot: The amount on each line is quantity times rate, worked out on the server from the two figures it stores — the column on screen is a preview of the same sum.
hint.bill_locked: :no is :status — it is no longer rewritten.

empty.receive_lines: A receive challan with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
empty.bill_lines: A twist bill with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.

line.need_particulars: A line with no challan has to say what the adjustment is.

v.received: :no has receives against it — its yarn lines are what the party was sent and cannot be rewritten.
v.yarn: Every line needs the programme line it comes back against.
v.program_status: :no is :status — nothing is received against it.
v.no_receive_lines: A receive challan with no lines takes nothing back.
v.over: Line :n takes back more grey than the programme line has left (:left Kg).

v.bill_fixed: :no is :status — it can no longer be rewritten.

v.no_bill_lines: A twist bill with no lines owes the twister nothing.

hint.register: Every Y/D programme, with what the store has issued against it, what has come back dyed and what is still with the party.
hint.program_form: Greige yarn placed on a dye house for a buyer's order. One line per shade to come back; the store issues the greige against the programme on a Yarn Dye requisition.
hint.existing: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
hint.order: Picking the order fills its buyer.
hint.shades: Each shade the dye house is to return: its colour, the greige yarn it is dyed from and the weight. Delivered is what confirmed receipts have brought back.
hint.program_used: Shades already received against stay on the programme; they can be corrected but not removed.
hint.program_foot: Saving keeps the programme as entered. A change agreed with the dye house afterwards is recorded on Y/D Program Revisions.
hint.revisions: Pick the programme; its party and figures show here. A revision is numbered in order and says why the programme changed.
hint.rev_auto: Issued in order when the revision is saved.
hint.receipt_list: Nothing is narrowed until Show is pressed; the grid opens on the receipts most recently raised.
hint.receipt_form: Dyed yarn back from the house it was sent to. Pick the programme on the left and its shades arrive with what is still outstanding on each; correct them to what was counted at the gate.
hint.receive_no: Issued when the receipt is first saved.
hint.party_receipt: The dye house the cones came back from.
hint.receipt_lines: One line per shade received. The quantity opens on what the programme still has out; the lot is what is printed on the cone label.
hint.receipt_foot: Saving writes a draft and moves nothing. Confirm it on the Y/D Program List, which is what books the weight against the programme and lets the store issue the cones.
hint.loss_list: A memo is a draft until it is approved. Approving it is what writes the loss onto the programme, which is why a draft changes no statement.
hint.loss_form: Write a dye house's shrinkage off against the programme it happened on. The memo is a draft until it is approved on the register — approving is what moves the programme's figures.
hint.loss_program: Every line on the memo has to belong to this programme.
hint.loss_lines: One line per shade. Loss Qty is Issued − Received and Loss % is that against what was issued — the ratio a dye house is actually held to.
hint.loss_foot: A memo is not what changes the programme — approving it is. Until then it can be corrected here as often as it needs to be.
hint.rp_list: The grid opens on everything raised on this screen, most recent first.
hint.rp_ih_form: Dyed yarn off the mill's own shelf that has to be run again. Name the dye house, list the lots, and say what is wrong with each.
hint.rp_sc_form: Dyed yarn recovered from a sub-contract knitter and sent on to be run again. Both ends of the movement are named: who it came from, and who is re-running it.
hint.ref_no: Issued when the document is first saved.
hint.factory: The dye house the yarn is going to.
hint.sc_party: The sub-contract knitter the cones are being recovered from.
hint.rp_program: The programme the yarn was dyed under, when it came off one.
hint.rp_lines: One line per lot. The reason is what the dye house is being asked to correct — off-shade, streaky, tippy.
hint.rp_foot: Saving writes a draft. Issue it on the register when the lorry leaves — an issued document can no longer be edited here.
hint.syc_form: Yarn a party has sent in for the mill to knit. Pick the programme on the left — a challan is always against one — then add the challan and the lines that came with it.
hint.syc_challan: The party's own challan number. Left blank, the store issues one.
hint.syc_lines: What came in with the challan. These lines count as a receipt on the month's ledger, so the lot has to be the one written on the cartons.
hint.syc_list: Yarn a sub-contract party has sent in for the mill to knit — the challan, the programme it belongs to and the store it went into
hint.syc_foot: Saving writes a draft. Issue hands it to the store; accepting it is what takes the cones onto the ledger.
hint.statement: With Party is Greige Issue − Dyed Recv − Process Loss. A negative figure means more came back than went out, which is a keying error on one of the three and not a gain.
hint.locked: :no is :status, so it can no longer be edited here.

hint.stock: Leave the boxes empty for every store. Print Challan sits on each note's own row, because a challan is one store's day rather than a search.
hint.report_type: Fabric Stock is roll by roll; Receive Notes is the day's paper, which is what Print Challan prints.
hint.receive: Scan a roll tag to take it into the fabric store. Each scan is recorded on its own — there is nothing to save.
hint.rack: Must be a rack in the store chosen above.
hint.store_first: Pick the store and the rack first — a roll put somewhere nobody recorded is a roll the stock report can count but nobody can find.
hint.receive_foot: :scanned roll(s) scanned · :ticked ticked · A roll is received into a store once. Confirming closes the day's receipt: its rolls can no longer be withdrawn here, and the challan can be printed from the register.
hint.confirmed: This day is confirmed (:no) — its rolls stay where they were received.
hint.close: Show Exception lists what would stop the close without changing anything. Month Close applies the same checks again and strikes the month if they pass.
hint.month: A month is closed after it has finished.
hint.no_exceptions: Nothing stands in the way of closing :period.
hint.ob_list: The three printed tabs are the panels beside this one, where a search is ticked and finalised in one go. This grid is all three at once.
hint.ob_tab: Tick the open lines and press Finalize to put them into the grey ledger the month close reads.
hint.ob_entry: Saving writes an open line and moves nothing. Finalising it — on one of the three tabs beside this form — is what puts it into the grey ledger the month close reads.
hint.ob_kind: Which of the printed screen's three tabs this line belongs to.
hint.fabric: As the store writes it. This is what the grid is read by.
hint.adj_form: Physical-count corrections against the grey fabric store. Positive puts fabric on the shelf, negative takes it off.
hint.existing: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
hint.adj_no: Issued when the adjustment is first saved.
hint.adj_lines: One line per stock line corrected. The order, the shade and the fabric together are what the store's balance is struck on, so all three have to match the line being corrected.
hint.adj_foot: Saving moves nothing. The weight reaches the grey ledger when the adjustment is verified on the list and then approved, and it lands in the month end that covers its date.
hint.adj_list: Physical-count corrections booked against the grey fabric store — where each stands, what it moved and why
hint.locked: :no is :status, so it can no longer be edited here.
hint.tr_list: Nothing filled in lists the most recent transfers. New opens the entry form, where the rolls being moved are written against the two stores.
hint.tr_form: Move grey fabric from one store to another. The order it is held against does not change — only where the rolls are.
hint.trans_type: Which kind of order the fabric moves between — not the same thing as which stores it moves between.
hint.trans_ref: The reference the other desk quotes for this movement. Not the transfer number, which this screen issues.
hint.tr_lines: One line per roll or per quantity. Pick a roll where the desk moves weighed rolls; type a roll number and a weight where it moves a balance that has no roll behind it.
hint.tr_foot: The transfer number is issued on save. Submitting the requisition and receiving it are done from the register — this form only writes what is being moved.

v.rack_store: Must be a rack in the store chosen above.
v.roll_received: :roll is already in the store (:no) — a roll is received once.
v.roll_moved: :roll is :where, not on the knitting floor.

v.not_finished: :period has not finished yet — a month is closed after it has finished.

v.no_transfer_lines: A transfer with no fabric on it moves nothing.
v.line_store: Line :n is not held in the From Store.

v.roll_twice: Line :n moves a roll already on this transfer.
v.line_over: Line :n moves more than the store holds (:have kg).
v.short: :line has only :have kg left in the store.

form.COLLAR_CUFF: Collar and cuff off the flat beds, going to the grey store. Pick the rolls, say which part they are, and the store they are going to.
form.TO_BATCH: Grey fabric leaving the knitting store for a dye batch. Pick the batch it is being gathered onto and the rolls that are going.
form.ORDER: Move grey fabric from one order's account onto another's. Both ends are orders, and they have to be two different ones.
form.REUSE: Pull left-over grey back into a live order instead of knitting new. The fabric comes out of the left-over store and onto an order.
form.TO_LEFTOVER: Move unconsumed grey out of the grey store and into left-over. The fabric comes off an order and goes into a store, where it waits to be reused.
form.BATCH_TO_LEFTOVER: Move unconsumed grey out of the batch store and into left-over. Only fabric held on a dye batch is offered.

hint.category: Which pair of order categories this movement is between.
hint.to_order: Only when the fabric is being credited to another order.
hint.batch: The dye batch the grey is being gathered onto.
hint.rolls: One line per roll. Picking a roll fills its fabric, shade and net weight — correct the weight only if the receiving store counted differently.

foot.COLLAR_CUFF: Saving writes a draft; the rolls move when the transfer is received on the register. A roll already promised to another open transfer is refused here rather than discovered later.
foot.TO_BATCH: Saving writes a draft; the rolls move to the batch store when the transfer is received on the register. Only batches that have not finished are offered.

hint.racks: Rack and bin position of every grey roll held on the floor. A roll's yarn is what its knit card says, which is what Spin Type, Cotton Type, Brand and Lot narrow by.

empty.rolls: A transfer with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
empty.racks: No racking line matches that search

v.same_order: From Order# and To Order# have to be two different orders.
v.no_rolls: A transfer with no rolls on it moves nothing.
v.roll_floor: Line :n: :roll is not a roll of the From Order still on the knitting floor.
v.roll_promised: :roll is already promised to another open transfer, or already received.
v.roll_on_move: :roll is on open transfer :no — receive or cancel that first.
v.not_batch: Line :n is not held on a dye batch.
v.batch_roll: Line :n is not a grey roll in store (only weighed rolls go onto a batch, and once).

hint.prog_form: Hand a received sub-contract programme, and the yarn held against it, from one outside knitter to another.
hint.grey_form: Greige yarn leaving for a dye house. Pick the Y/D programme on the left and its shades arrive with what is still to send on each; correct them to what went on the lorry.
hint.dyed_form: Dyed yarn back from the house it was sent to. Pick the grey challan it answers on the left and its shades arrive in the grid; correct them to what was counted at the gate.
hint.fwd_form: Dyed yarn going on to an outside knitter. Pick a Y/D receive challan on the left — Include Challan — and everything still unforwarded on it drops into the grid.
hint.existing: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
hint.challan_no: Issued when the challan is first saved.
hint.sc_program: Only programmes still running are offered — a closed one has no work left to hand over.
hint.to_party: The knitter taking the programme on.
hint.prog_lines: The yarn going with the programme — item, shade and lot, because that is how a store counts a cone and how the receiving party will count it back.
hint.prog_foot: Saving writes a draft. Finalizing it on the register is what moves the programme onto the receiving party's account.
hint.grey_party: Whose greige is on the challan.
hint.yd_program: Left blank when the challan is raised at the gate before the programme is placed.
hint.grey_store: Blank takes the store the first line's cones sit in; every line leaves from it.
hint.grey_lines: One line per shade going out. Picking a programme shade fills the yarn, the colour and the outstanding weight; the lot is what is printed on the cone label.
hint.grey_foot: Saving writes a draft. Issuing it takes the cones off the yarn store; finalising it on the list is what both ends sign, and what lets a dyed yarn receipt quote this challan for its G.Yarn Qty.
hint.dyed_party: The dye house the cones came back from.
hint.grey_challan: The challan the greige went out on. Its weight is the register's G.Yarn Qty.
hint.dyed_store: The yarn store the cones go onto when the receipt is finalised.
hint.dyed_lines: One line per shade received. The knitting and collar programmes are on the line, because one delivery routinely covers several.
hint.dyed_foot: Saving writes a draft. Finalising it on the list is the store signing for the count, and it is what lets the yarn be forwarded to an outside knitter.
hint.fwd_party: The out-house knitter the yarn is going to.
hint.fwd_lines: One line per shade forwarded. Each names the receive line it came off, so what is left on that delivery is always the received weight less what has gone out.
hint.fwd_foot: Every line carries the receive line it came off, which is what answers the Transfer? column on the receive register and what stops one delivery being forwarded twice.

hint.req_list: Type opens on Bulk, as the printed screen does. Closed requirements are left out unless the box is ticked — closing one is the merchandiser saying no more of that part will be made.
hint.req_form: A requirement has to ask for something: at least one of the two quantities must be more than nothing. Output is recorded on the production desk, one day at a time.
hint.req_order: The job the parts are needed for. A requirement may be raised against a work style before the order is booked.
hint.saved: Saved records are written to PostgreSQL and recorded in the audit trail.
hint.prod_desk: Pick the requirement on the left and record what came off the machines against it. In-house and sub-contract are counted apart, because the register compares each against its own requirement.
hint.prod_rule: Rejects are kept beside the accepted pieces rather than netted off them: the requirement is met by what is usable, and the loss is still a fact the floor is asked about.
hint.sc_program: Only for sub-contract output: the out-house programme the pieces were knitted on.
hint.program_list: Nothing filled in loads the most recent programmes. Received is what the store's collar/cuff challans have booked in against the programme, so it is a join rather than a figure anybody types.
hint.program_form: Flat-knit work placed on an outside party. The CPI on the header is what the knitter is told and quotes back; the rate on each line is what they are paid per piece.
hint.existing: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
hint.issued_on_save: Issued when it is first saved.
hint.delivery_date: When the party is to have the pieces back with the store.
hint.cpi: Courses per inch, as the party writes it.
hint.program_lines: One line per part the party is to knit. Size and gauge are on the line because a programme routinely covers several sizes of one collar.
hint.program_foot: A programme has to name at least one part, and every part has to ask for pieces. Received quantities are the store's own — this desk never writes them.
hint.yarn_list: Nothing filled in loads the most recent requisitions raised on this screen. Issued is the sum of what the store has released line by line, so the balance is always the requisition less what has actually gone out.
hint.yarn_form: Pick the order on the left and its open flat-knit parts drop into the grid. Say which yarn each needs and how much, and saving writes the requisition as a draft.
hint.yarn_program: Set when the yarn is drawn for work placed on an outside party.
hint.yarn_lines_SOLID: One line per yarn the plan calls for — undyed or already-dyed stock the store holds against this order.
hint.yarn_lines_YD: One line per yarn-dyed shade the plan calls for. The lot matters here in a way it does not on the solid desk: two lots of one shade are two shades on a collar.
hint.yarn_foot: Saving writes a draft. Submit Requisition on the list is what sends it to the store, and approving it there is what lets yarn be issued against it.
hint.issue_desk: Approved requisitions on the left, the yarn each asks for on the right. Pick the stock line the store released from and the quantity; the requisition's standing follows it.
hint.challan_list: Nothing filled in loads the most recent challans. Rcv Date is empty until the store signs for the challan — receiving it is what fills that column in and what puts the pieces onto the programme.
hint.challan_form: Pick the order on the left and its open flat-knit parts drop into the grid with what is still outstanding on each. Correct them to what is actually going, and save.
hint.from_floor: The flat-bed floor the pieces came off.
hint.challan_lines: One line per part on the paper. A line naming a requirement is what makes it count towards that requirement's delivery; a line naming none is stock moving for its own reasons.
hint.challan_foot: Saving writes a draft. Issue hands it to whoever is carrying the pieces; Receive at Store is the store counting them in, and that is what fills the Rcv Date column.
hint.locked: :no is :status — it can no longer be changed here.
