guide.hint: Check how each unit works out Cost/Pc before budgeting
guide.title: Unit Guide: how Cost/Pc is worked out
guide.lead: The Cost/Pc of a line comes from its Unit. Put the Rate in the unit the supplier quotes it in (per dozen, per gross, per cone …), then check the sum here.
guide.name: Name
guide.no_rule: This unit has no Cost/Pc rule yet: its lines get no cost. Add the rule in Acc Budget Column Setup.
guide.where: The rules are set by the company in Acc Budget Column Setup → Unit Cost Rules; the worksheet uses the same ones.

bom.formula_col: Worked out by a formula (Acc Budget Column Setup)
bom.rules_hint: Cost/Pc comes from the unit's rule (Master Data → Acc Budget Column Setup → Unit Cost Rules); the columns and formulas are set there too.

rules.title: Unit Cost Rules
rules.hint: For each unit, the formula a BOM row's Unit Rule Cost (what Cost/Pc reads) is worked out with. Write column names in [ ]; a rule reads typed and style columns.
rules.delete_confirm: Delete the rule for :unit? A row in :unit then has no Cost/Pc until a rule is added again.

bom.delete_text: Its styles are free again for another BOM.
bom.styles_head: Styles (:done/:n budgeted) — tick a style to open it
bom.no_styles: Tick a style above to start its accessories budget.
bom.search: Search BOM, budget, buyer, brand, job no, style
bom.locked: This budget is waiting for approval or approved: its BOMs cannot change.
bom.all_budgeted: Every style of this budget is in a BOM.
bom.unit_hint: Cost/Pc by unit: DZN Rate÷12×B · CONE/BOX/KG Rate÷I×B · PCS/SET Rate×I÷B (or Rate÷B) · ROLL Rate÷B

v.style_group: The Style group holds the style's own cells: put the column in another group.
v.rule_reads: A unit rule reads typed and style columns only, not: :columns.
v.no_rule: Style :style, row :row: unit :unit has no Unit Cost Rule (Acc Budget Column Setup).
v.no_value: Style :style, row :row: Total Value cannot be worked out — fill :fields.
v.conflict: Someone saved this BOM meanwhile. Load it again and redo your change.
v.final_delete: Only a draft BOM can be deleted.
v.not_budget_style: Style :style is not in this budget (or ticked twice).
v.style_taken: Style :style is already in another BOM.

final.title: Approval (Merchandising Head → CFO → MD)
final.nobody: Nobody set to sign — Approval Center → Approval Workflow
final.no_chain: No approval chain: the budget is approved when finalized.

confirm.finalize_text: It goes to the Approval Center (Merchandising Head → CFO → MD) and cannot change while it waits.
confirm.withdraw_text: It leaves the Approval Center and is a draft again, to change and finalize later.
confirm.revise_text: A copy (-R1, -R2 …) with its requisitions, costing, stock and BOMs takes its place as a draft; this approved budget is kept as it was.

v.unassigned: Nobody signs these approval steps yet: :steps. Set them in Approval Center → Approval Workflow (Pre-Budget Approval).
v.not_withdrawable: Only a budget waiting for approval can be withdrawn, by whoever sent it.
v.not_revisable: Only an approved budget can be revised.
v.requisition_locked: Requisition S/N :serial is in budget :budget, waiting for approval or approved: change it through the budget's Revise.
v.reason: Write the reason for the rejection.

print.forbidden: You may not print this budget.
print.error: This print could not be made.

overview.choose: Choose a budget above to see its order overview.

procurement.unknown_item: That item is not in your item library.
procurement.item_inactive: :item has been retired and cannot be added to a new document.
procurement.items_inactive_on_submit: These items were retired while this was in draft: :items. Remove them before submitting.
procurement.only_draft_editable: Only a draft can be edited (this one is :status).
procurement.pr_not_convertible: A purchase order can only be raised from an approved requisition (this one is :status).
procurement.pr_line_over_ordered: Only :pending of :item is still outstanding on the requisition.
procurement.unknown_pr_line: That requisition line does not exist.
procurement.unknown_po_line: That purchase order line does not exist.
procurement.po_not_revisable: Only an approved order can be revised (this one is :status).
procurement.po_not_receivable: Goods can only be received against an approved order (this one is :status).
procurement.po_line_below_received: :item has already been partly received; the order cannot be cut below that.
procurement.revision_needs_reason: Give a reason for the revision.
procurement.vendor_cannot_supply: That vendor is not an active supplier.
procurement.store_not_in_factory: That store does not belong to the chosen factory.
procurement.bin_required_in_store: Choose a bin in the receiving store for :item.
procurement.over_receipt: Only :pending of :item is outstanding on the order. Revise the order or allow over-receipt in settings.
procurement.search_items: Search items by code or name…
procurement.no_items_in_department: No active items in this department.
procurement.open_duplicates: Other open requisitions ask for some of these items
procurement.open_duplicates_hint: A warning, not a block — check before you approve.
procurement.revise_hint: The order as it stands is saved to the revision history first. A revision that costs more than was approved goes back through approval; a line already partly received cannot be cut below what came in.
procurement.close_order_hint: Marks the outstanding balance as not coming.
procurement.complete_hint: Posts every line to stock. Cannot be undone.
procurement.no_outstanding_lines: Nothing is outstanding on this order.
procurement.booking_hint: Yardage held with the mill before there is a purchase order. Confirming it stakes a claim on the incoming stock, so the same metres are not planned for twice.
procurement.booking_item_not_in_bom: :item is not on style :style’s bill of materials.
procurement.over_booking_hint: Confirmed anyway — a booking follows the buyer’s forecast, which moves. Check it is deliberate.
procurement.material_requirement_hint: Worked out live from the bill of materials. Stock held for somebody else does not count as available, so the number is what still has to be bought rather than what is lying around.
procurement.requirement_pr_notes: Raised from the material requirement for cutting programme :number.
procurement.requirement_already_raised: Requisition :number was already raised for this programme.
procurement.requirement_fully_covered: Nothing is short — stock, bookings and open orders cover this programme.
procurement.no_bom_for_requirement: This style has no bill of materials, so nothing can be worked out.
procurement.landed_cost_hint: Freight, duty and clearing arrive weeks after the goods do. Spreading them over the consignment is what turns the purchase rate into what the stock actually cost.
procurement.preview_ready: Distribution worked out — check it before posting.
procurement.preview_empty: Nothing on these receipts can carry the charges yet.
procurement.post_warning: Posting moves the weighted average and re-prices fabric rolls, some of which may already be cut or issued. It cannot be undone — a mistake is corrected with a second voucher carrying the opposite charges.
procurement.rate_locked_hint: Landed cost has been posted against this receipt, so its rates are part of a valuation already reported.
procurement.landed_cost_needs_charges: A landed cost voucher needs at least one charge.
procurement.landed_cost_needs_receipts: Name the goods receipts these charges brought in.
procurement.landed_cost_nothing_to_apply: Nothing on these receipts can carry the charges.
procurement.landed_cost_receipt_not_posted: :number is :status, so it has no valuation to lift yet.
procurement.unknown_receipt: That goods receipt is not available to your company.
procurement.return_hint: Approval first, then the gate pass, then the stock comes down, then the supplier is debited. Nothing leaves the shelf until it is approved.
procurement.dispatch_hint: The gate pass, the stock movement and the debit note happen together — at the gate they are one event.
procurement.no_returns: Nothing has been returned to a supplier.
procurement.return_search_placeholder: Search by return or debit note number…
procurement.return_receipt_not_posted: :number is :status, so nothing of it is on the shelf to take back.
procurement.return_needs_vendor: A direct receipt with no supplier cannot be returned to one.
procurement.return_not_dispatchable: A :status return cannot be sent out.
procurement.return_exceeds_received: Only :available of :item is left to return.
procurement.roll_not_returnable: Roll :roll cannot be returned while it is :status — raise a claim instead.
procurement.unknown_receipt_line: That line is not on this goods receipt.
procurement.claim_hint: When the cloth has already been cut there is nothing to send back, but the loss is just as real — so what is claimed is money. No stock moves.
procurement.claim_not_open: A :status claim cannot take a settlement.
procurement.settlement_exceeds_claim: Only :outstanding of this claim is still outstanding.
procurement.advance_hint: A mill will not start weaving on a promise. Until the bills arrive this money is owed back in goods — the number that matters is what is still unaccounted for.
procurement.no_advances: No advances paid to a supplier.
procurement.adjustment_exceeds_advance: Only :outstanding of this advance is left.
procurement.adjustment_already_reversed: That adjustment has already been reversed.
procurement.advance_already_used: Part of this advance has been used, so it cannot be cancelled.
procurement.advance_order_vendor_mismatch: That order belongs to a different supplier.
procurement.advance_receipt_vendor_mismatch: That receipt is from a different supplier.
procurement.unknown_order: That purchase order is not available to your company.
procurement.import_documents_hint: The supplier's proforma invoice is what the bank opens a letter of credit against, and the shipment sails against both. A revised invoice is a new version, never an edit — the bank opened against the old one.
procurement.pi_revised: Version :version raised; the earlier one is now superseded.
procurement.pi_not_revisable: A :status proforma invoice cannot be revised.
procurement.unknown_proforma_invoice: That proforma invoice does not belong to this order.
procurement.lc_variance_hint: The difference between what the bank has committed and what the order is worth. A gap either way has to be amended before shipment.
procurement.lc_pi_not_live: That proforma invoice is :status — an LC cannot be opened against a document the supplier has replaced.
procurement.lc_not_amendable: A :status letter of credit cannot be amended.
procurement.lc_amendment_needs_reason: An amendment costs a bank charge and changes what the supplier can draw — say why.
procurement.lc_not_shippable: A :status letter of credit cannot carry a shipment.
procurement.unknown_letter_of_credit: That letter of credit does not belong to this order.
procurement.eta_hint: The first ETA is kept beside the current one. The gap between what was promised and what happened is the supplier's delivery record.
procurement.document_status_hint: Goods that have landed but whose papers are still at the bank cannot be cleared, so the two are tracked apart.
procurement.shipments_empty: Nothing on the water for this order yet.
procurement.shipment_search_placeholder: Search by shipment, B/L or container number…
procurement.no_proforma_invoices: No proforma invoice on this order yet.
procurement.no_letters_of_credit: No letter of credit on this order yet.
procurement.landed_cost_no_receipts: No completed receipt at this factory to charge.
procurement.basis_hint: By value where the charge follows what the goods are worth (duty, insurance); by quantity where it follows bulk (freight).
procurement.return_stock_moved: Sent out and taken off the shelf; debit note :debit_note.
procurement.contract_hint: A price fixed with a supplier for a period, so an order raised in September does not depend on somebody remembering what was agreed in March. A line that names its own rate keeps it — the contract only fills in what was left blank.
procurement.company_wide_hint: A price negotiated with a mill is normally a group price. Leave this on unless the agreement really is for one factory.
procurement.min_quantity_hint: The quantity this price starts at. Leave at zero for the base price, and add another line for a price break.
procurement.no_contracts: No rate contract has been agreed yet.
procurement.contract_search_placeholder: Search by contract number or supplier…
procurement.contract_needs_lines: A rate contract needs at least one agreed price.
procurement.contract_not_editable: A :status contract cannot be edited — orders have already been priced from it. Cancel it and agree a new one.
procurement.contract_rate_must_be_positive: An agreed rate has to be more than zero.
procurement.contract_period_backwards: The contract cannot end before it starts.
procurement.contract_collides: :item is already priced by contract :number over these dates. Two live agreements leave no way to say which is the price.
procurement.scorecard_hint: Scored on what the system already recorded — deliveries against promised dates, goods sent back, prices against what other suppliers charged, and claims raised. A measure with nothing behind it is left out rather than scored zero, so the card says which ones counted.
procurement.on_time_hint: Receipts against an order that promised a date. Orders with no promised date are left out — there is nothing to be late against.
procurement.quality_hint: By value, not by count: a rejected roll and a rejected button are not the same failure.
procurement.price_hint: This supplier against what everyone charged for the same items. 1.00 is the market rate; below it is cheaper. Blank when nobody else sold them.
procurement.no_scorecards: No supplier has been scored yet.
procurement.scorecard_empty: Nothing was received from this supplier in the period, so there is nothing to score.

production.minimal_master_hint: A minimal order master, kept here only because the factory has no merchandising system to read it from. It holds what production planning needs and nothing else.
production.no_styles: No styles on this order yet.
production.bom_hint: What one garment consumes, in the item’s own unit. The wastage allowance is added on top when the requirement is worked out — it is what the factory plans to lose, not what it actually lost.
production.no_bom: No bill of materials yet — the requirement cannot be worked out without one.
production.issue_hint: Measured against the bill of materials as it goes. An issue that takes the programme past the factory’s tolerance waits for a sign-off — and the stock stays in the store until it has one.
production.stock_not_moved: Nothing has left the store yet — this issue is waiting for approval.
production.variance_approval_title: :item on :number is :percent% over the bill of materials.
production.no_issues: Nothing has been issued to this programme yet.
production.item_not_in_bom: :item is not on this style’s bill of materials.
production.program_not_issuable: A :status programme cannot be issued to.
production.unknown_style: That style is not available to your company.
production.style_no_taken: Style :style is already on this order.
production.item_twice_in_bom: :item is on the bill of materials twice.
production.program_exceeds_style: Only :remaining of style :style are left to programme.

descriptions.all-dashboard: Factory-wide production today: cutting bundles ready, sewing and finishing against approved targets.
descriptions.cutting-dashboard: Bundles ready for sewing by barcode, by buyer, style, PO and cutting date.
descriptions.sewing-dashboard: Total target, actual, reject and rework, and every sewing line's card.
descriptions.finishing-dashboard: Total target, actual, reject and rework, and every finishing line's card.
descriptions.buyer-wise: Sewing and finishing against target, buyer by buyer.
descriptions.style-wise: Sewing and finishing against target, style by style.
descriptions.po-wise: Sewing and finishing against target, PO by PO.
descriptions.tv-dashboard: Configure what each factory-floor TV shows, preview it and issue its display link.
descriptions.reports: The Daily Production Report: line by line, day by day.
descriptions.production-data: Add or delete each day's cutting, sewing and finishing figures — the Daily Production Report columns the dashboards show.
descriptions.line-capacity: Standard capacity of each sewing and finishing line, effective by date.
descriptions.daily-plan: Generate, submit and approve each line's daily target from its capacity.
descriptions.settings: Refresh interval, stale-data warning, approval workflow and achievement thresholds.

capacity.title: Capacities
capacity.without_hint: Line Capacity Not Configured — no daily target can be generated for these lines until a capacity is added.
capacity.includes_hint: Then the efficiency-adjusted method is refused for this line.

f.no_po: No PO — plan by buyer / style
f.note: Reason / note

kpi.cut_in_period: PCS · :n bundles cut in the period
kpi.received_sewing: PCS · :n bundles already received by sewing

board.sewing_defects_note: Reject and Rework are the defects Quality inspection found, charged to the sewing line that sewed the bundle. They are never added to Actual.
board.finishing_defects_note: Reject and Rework are what Finishing Bundle OUT marked on each finishing line. They are never added to Actual.
board.no_target_lines: Daily Target Not Configured for :n line(s).
board.cutting_note: The ERP keeps no count of planned bundles, so Planned, Remaining and Ready % read N/A unless Production Master Data gives a cutting target. A bundle is Ready once its lay is cut and until Sewing Bundle IN receives it; a cancelled bundle never counts.
board.cutting_ready_rule: Ready = lay cut, not cancelled, not yet received by Sewing Bundle IN
board.sections_apart: Each section in its own unit; never combined.
board.sewing_missing: Sewing: Daily Target Not Configured for :n line(s).
board.finishing_missing: Finishing: Daily Target Not Configured for :n line(s).
board.trend_hint: Cumulative pieces off the sewing lines by hour, against the day's approved target
board.buyer_top_hint: Sewing actual against approved sewing target
board.progress_hint: Sewing and finishing actual against their approved targets in the period.

empty.period: Nothing produced in the selected period.
empty.bundles: No bundles were cut in the selected period.
empty.CUTTING_entries: No cutting entry for this day.
empty.SEWING_entries: No sewing entry for this day.
empty.FINISHING_entries: No finishing entry for this day.

plan.workflow_on: Approval workflow is on — only approved targets reach the dashboards and TVs.
plan.workflow_off: Approval workflow is off — a submitted plan is approved at once.
plan.form_hint: Buyer, Style, PO and Line come from the ERP. The target is generated from the line's capacity on the production date.
plan.pick_line: Select a line to load its capacity.
plan.blank_calculated: Leave blank to use the calculated target.
plan.override_hint: Only needed when overriding the calculated target

entry.rows_hint: :n row(s) · counted on the :dash and All dashboards
entry.form_hint: The Daily Production Report columns of one line for one day. Target and Production are counted on the dashboards; the rest shows on the line's card.
entry.delete_hint: Its figures leave the dashboards and the report.

tv.intro: Each TV shows its own saved selection of Sewing or Finishing lines, today, with the approved daily target. Open a screen on a TV with its display link; it needs no ERP sign-in and cannot change anything.
tv.preview_hint: Exactly what the TV shows now. Previewing never changes or replaces its display link.
tv.link_once: Copy it now: it is shown once. Replacing it stops the old link at once.
tv.delete_hint: The TV showing it stops at its next refresh.

settings.live_hint: How often dashboards and TVs re-read the ERP, and when their data is marked stale.
settings.refresh_hint: 15–600 seconds. 15–60 is recommended; each TV can set its own.
settings.stale_hint: At least two refresh intervals; up to 3600.
settings.plan_hint: The approval workflow and the target methods offered.
settings.approval_hint: On: a submitted plan waits for an approver, and only an approved target appears on the dashboards and TVs.
settings.smv_hint: Target = (Operators × Net Minutes × Efficiency) ÷ Style SMV. Turn on only once the business has approved this method and style SMVs are maintained.
settings.thresholds_hint: The approved bands behind the green, amber and red colours on line cards and TVs.
settings.no_target_grey: A line without an approved target shows grey, "No target", whatever its output.
settings.configured_hint: Read from the ERP and this module right now.
settings.users_hint: Users, roles and passwords are managed in Access Control; Production Tracking uses those same roles.

who.view_roles: Everyone with the module: factory admin and manager, line chief, maintenance manager
who.approve_roles: Factory admin, factory manager — never one's own plan
who.entry_roles: Factory admin, factory manager, line chief

toast.revised: :no revised — a new draft revision is open.

v.capacity_overlap: This line already has a capacity in force in that period.
v.stale: Mark data stale after at least two refresh intervals.
v.method_needs_hourly: Method A needs a capacity in pieces per hour.
v.method_c_refused: This line's capacity already includes efficiency — the efficiency-adjusted method is refused.
v.method_c_efficiency: Method C needs an efficiency on the line's capacity.
v.method_d_off: The SMV-based method is not enabled in Settings.
v.method_d_inputs: Method D needs operators, SMV and efficiency.
v.no_capacity: Line Capacity Not Configured for :date — add one on Line Capacity Master first.
v.override_reason: Give a reason for overriding the calculated target.
v.plan_exists: This line already has plan :no for that day.
v.plan_locked: Only a draft or rejected plan can be edited.
v.plan_status: Not possible while the plan is :status.
v.own_plan: A plan is approved by someone other than the one who prepared it.
v.tv_name: Give the TV screen a name.
v.tv_link: This display link is not valid any more.

ui.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
ui.no_choices: No records to choose from yet.
ui.attachment_placeholder: Path or link, or attach a file
ui.no_lines_hint: Nothing to show here until a record is loaded.

req.list_hint: Sample requisitions with their number, date, buyer, style, sample type and where each one stands.
req.form_hint: Pick a requisition to open it, or fill the form to raise one. Submit sends it to the merchandiser, merchandising manager and sample manager in turn.
req.approval_hint: Requisitions waiting on a decision, and the ones already decided for reference. Pick one, record Approve or Reject with your comments, and save.

confirm.submit_hint: :no goes to the merchandiser, then the merchandising manager, then the sample manager.
confirm.assign_hint: The sample is handed to the person in Assigned To (:who), who is notified. — :no. The decision is recorded in the audit trail.
confirm.cancel_hint: :no and any sample it minted are cancelled. This cannot be undone.

h.req_no: Issued on the first save, e.g. SR-2026-00001.
h.order_no: Required for sample types configured as order- or PO-bound.
h.style_no: Only the chosen buyer's styles are offered.
h.product_category: Taken from the style when left blank.
h.sample_stage: Left blank, the sample type's configured default stage is used.
h.assigned_to: The sample room person responsible once it is approved.
h.assigned_level: Sample Manager level only. Approving with an assignee assigns the sample immediately.

req.history_hint: Every decision taken on this requisition, level by level. Decisions are never edited or removed.
req.form_note: A requisition can be edited while it is a draft or after it has been rejected (saving a rejected one returns it to Draft). Once approved, only Assigned To is taken from the form. The sample number is minted when the sample manager approves.
req.approval_note: Each level decides in turn: Merchandiser, then Merchandising Manager, then Sample Manager. A rejection needs a reason and sends the requisition back to the merchandiser. The Sample Manager's approval mints the sample number.

dev.list_hint: Sample developments with their number, sample and version, buyer, style, schedule and checklist progress.
dev.form_hint: Pick a development to update its checklist, or choose an approved sample to start one. One development is kept per version of a sample.

h.dev_no: Issued on the first save, e.g. DEV-2026-00001.
h.sample: Only an approved, open sample can be developed. Fixed once the development is saved.
h.actual_completion: Defaults to today when the development completes.

dev.checklist_hint: The fourteen development points. Mark each one as it is done, or Not Required where it does not apply to this sample.
dev.note: Progress is completed tasks over applicable tasks. Not Required tasks do not count. When every applicable task is completed, or the status is set to Completed, the development is closed and locked.

rev.list_hint: Sample revisions with their number, sample, the version change, date, reason and sign-off.
rev.form_hint: Pick a revision to open it, or choose a sample and describe the change to raise one. Raising a revision moves the sample to its next version.

h.rev_no: Issued on the first save, e.g. REV-2026-00001.
h.sample_no: Fixed once the revision is saved.

rev.history_hint: Every version this sample has been moved through, oldest first.
rev.note: Saving a new revision sets the sample to the next version and back to Revision · In Progress. The previous version's QC, approvals and handover stay on file. A revision can be edited only while it is Open, and is never removed.

qc.list_hint: Quality checks with their sample, version, defects and who checked.
qc.form_hint: Pick a check to correct it, or fill the form to record one. The verdict and its checklist are saved together, and the verdict moves the sample.
qc.empty: No quality check has been raised yet.

h.sample_no: Samples waiting in Quality, or back in Production / Approval for a re-check.
h.version: The check is recorded against the sample's current version.
h.defect: Required for Fail and Rework Required.

qc.checklist_hint: One line per checkpoint. A Not OK checkpoint needs the defect; a Major or Critical one cannot be passed outright.
qc.note: Pass or Pass with Comment puts the sample up for approval; Fail keeps it in Quality for correction; Rework Required sends it back to production. Only the latest check of the current version can be corrected, and not once an approval has been raised on it.

appr.list_hint: Merchandising reviews and buyer approvals with their decision and how long each waited.
appr.form_hint: Put a QC-passed sample up for merchandising review or buyer approval, and record the decision. Pick an approval to decide it.
appr.empty: No sample approval has been raised yet.

h.qc_ref: The passed QC, linked on save
h.approval_date: Left blank on a decision, today.
h.approval_by: As signed on the buyer's comment sheet
h.buyer_comment: Rejected and Revision Required need a buyer or internal comment.

appr.note: Approval without a passed QC is refused, and buyer approval needs an approved merchandising review on the same version. A decided approval is locked. Rejected and Revision Required are answered with Create Revision.

fb.list_hint: What buyers said about samples, the action asked for and who has it.
fb.form_hint: Record what the buyer said about a sample and who has to act on it. Pick a feedback to follow it up.
fb.empty: No buyer feedback has been raised yet.

h.action_required: Requires Assigned To and Due Date; the assignee is alerted immediately.

fb.note: Action Required needs an assignee and a due date, and the assignee is alerted on save. Resolved or Closed clears the alert. A closed feedback is locked.

ho.list_hint: Samples handed over or couriered, and where each one has reached.
ho.form_hint: Hand an approved sample over, or courier it and track it to the receiver. Pick a handover to move it along.
ho.empty: No sample handover has been raised yet.
ho.remove_hint: :no is removed and the quantity is free to hand over again. Only a Ready handover can be removed.

h.qty: No more than the sample quantity.

ho.note: A sample cannot be handed over without the approval its type requires. Couriered needs the courier and tracking number, Delivered the actual delivery date, and Received who received it and when. A received handover is locked; only a Ready one can be removed.

dt.list_hint: Sample room day sheets with their date, room, line count, total target, achievement and capacity.
dt.empty: No day sheet has been set yet.
dt.form_hint: Pick a day sheet to edit it, or set the date and fill the grid to start one. Total Target, Average WH and planned hours are computed from the lines.
dt.remove_hint: The day sheet for :date and its lines are removed. A closed sheet is kept.

h.target_date: One sheet per day — opening a date that already has one loads it.
h.available_manpower: Hands present today — no more than the total.

dt.lines_hint: What each sample line is asked to produce, for which sample, in what hours and with what manpower — and what it came to.
dt.no_lines_hint: A day sheet with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
dt.note: Saving replaces the day's lines with exactly what is in the grid. Capacity is available manpower × shift hours; a sheet planned past it saves with a warning. A closed sheet can no longer be edited.

tp.form_hint: Plan the sample room's target for a day, a week or a month, and see the day sheets inside the period with what each achieved.
tp.sheets_hint: The day sheets dated inside the plan's period — for its room, when the plan names one.
tp.note: A weekly plan spans exactly seven days and a monthly plan one calendar month. Planned hours past the available hours save with a warning.

mr.list_hint: Material requisitions with their sample, stores, lines, shortages and how much is issued.
mr.empty: No sample requisition has been raised yet.
mr.form_hint: Pick a requisition to edit it, or pick a sample and fill the form to raise one. The header, the sample programs it covers and the material lines are saved together; the buttons beside Save walk it through its approvals.

h.sample_no: Required for a new requisition. The requisition no, buyer and style follow the sample.
h.requested_by: The sample-section person the store should come back to.
h.requisition_type: What the store files the ask under — Fin Fab Req by Sample Section.
h.delivery_to: Where the issued material should be delivered.
h.rejection_reason: Save the reason first — Reject is refused without one.

mr.programs_hint: The sample programs this requisition covers, if any. The program number, company and date are the merchandiser's — they are shown as raised.
mr.programs_empty: No sample program attached — optional for a requisition raised against a sample.
mr.lines_hint: What the store is being asked for, and how much of it. Short Qty is the requirement less what the store reports available.

asset_register.title: Asset register
asset_register.description: Every machine on the books, with what it is and where it is.

asset_status.title: Asset status history
asset_status.description: How machine status changed over a period, and why.

asset_transfer.title: Asset transfers
asset_transfer.description: Machines moved between factories and locations, including those still in transit.

maintenance_history.title: Maintenance history
maintenance_history.description: What was done to a machine, when, and what it cost.

pm_compliance.title: PM compliance
pm_compliance.description: Preventive maintenance completed within its grace period, per machine.

overdue_maintenance.title: Overdue maintenance
overdue_maintenance.description: What is late right now, past its grace period.

breakdown_analysis.title: Breakdown analysis
breakdown_analysis.description: Every stoppage with its full timestamp chain.

root_cause.title: Root cause analysis
root_cause.description: Failures grouped by cause and failure code, with the downtime each caused.

downtime.title: Downtime
downtime.description: Measured downtime per stoppage, split into response, repair and hold time.

reliability.title: MTBF and MTTR
reliability.description: Reliability per machine: failures, mean time between them, and mean repair time.

maintenance_cost.title: Maintenance cost
maintenance_cost.description: Posted cost entries with their currency, rate and base amount.

lifecycle_cost.title: Lifecycle cost
lifecycle_cost.description: What each machine has cost since it arrived.

parts_consumption.title: Parts consumption
parts_consumption.description: Which spare parts were consumed, in what quantity and at what value.

inventory_valuation.title: Inventory valuation
inventory_valuation.description: Current stock on hand at weighted average cost.

technician_performance.title: Technician workload
technician_performance.description: Jobs assigned and completed, and labour hours booked.

vendor_performance.title: Vendor performance
vendor_performance.description: Claims filed against each vendor, how many they honoured, and how long they took.

coverage_expiry.title: Warranty and AMC expiry
coverage_expiry.description: Cover running out, soonest first, with what it will cost to keep.

item_stock_valuation.title: Item stock valuation
item_stock_valuation.description: What the item store holds and what it is worth, at weighted average cost.

item_reserved_vs_available.title: Reserved vs available
item_reserved_vs_available.description: What is spoken for and by whom, beside what is still free to issue.

item_stock_ageing.title: Stock ageing
item_stock_ageing.description: How long stock has sat, measured from the last time any of it arrived.

item_slow_moving.title: Slow and non-moving stock
item_slow_moving.description: Stock nobody has drawn on inside the window, and stock never issued at all.

item_lot_expiry.title: Lot expiry
item_lot_expiry.description: Dye and chemical lots still in stock, nearest expiry first.

fabric_roll_ledger.title: Roll ledger
fabric_roll_ledger.description: Every fabric roll, its shade and lot, where it is and what it is worth.

fabric_shade_stock.title: Shade-wise stock
fabric_shade_stock.description: Fabric grouped by shade and band — what can actually be cut together.

fabric_inspection_register.title: Inspection register
fabric_inspection_register.description: Rolls inspected in the period, with grade, points and defects.

fabric_roll_lineage.title: Split and merge history
fabric_roll_lineage.description: Rolls cut from another roll, or merged into one, with the piece they came from.

procurement_pending_requisitions.title: Pending purchase requisitions
procurement_pending_requisitions.description: Requisitions not yet ordered, and which of them are waiting on approval rather than on buying.

procurement_pending_orders.title: Pending purchase orders
procurement_pending_orders.description: Ordered and not yet received, line by line, with what is overdue against the date promised.

procurement_fabric_bookings.title: Fabric booking status
procurement_fabric_bookings.description: Fabric held with a mill, and whether it has turned into a requisition yet.

procurement_lc_outstanding.title: LC outstanding
procurement_lc_outstanding.description: Letters of credit still open, nearest expiry first, with their variance against the order.

procurement_shipment_eta.title: Shipment ETA
procurement_shipment_eta.description: What is on the water, when it lands, and how it ran against the ETA first promised.

procurement_landed_cost_summary.title: Landed cost summary
procurement_landed_cost_summary.description: What freight, duty and clearing added to each consignment, as a percentage of the goods.

procurement_return_register.title: Purchase return register
procurement_return_register.description: Goods returned to suppliers, including those approved but not yet sent out.

procurement_claim_register.title: Claim register
procurement_claim_register.description: Money claimed from suppliers in the period, and how much has been recovered.

procurement_advance_outstanding.title: Advance outstanding
procurement_advance_outstanding.description: Money paid to suppliers and not yet worked off, oldest first.

procurement_supplier_scorecard.title: Supplier scorecard
procurement_supplier_scorecard.description: How each supplier scored on delivery, quality, price and claims, with the measures that counted.

requisition_register.title: Floor requisition register
requisition_register.description: Every floor requisition in the period, by department and by requester.

requisition_pending.title: Pending floor requisitions
requisition_pending.description: What the floor is still waiting for, line by line, and how long it has waited.

requisition_auto_pr_trace.title: Shortage to purchase requisition
requisition_auto_pr_trace.description: Floor shortages and the purchase requisitions they raised, followed either way.

requisition_consumption.title: Consumption by person and item
requisition_consumption.description: What each person drew from the store, net of returnable stock that came back.

requisition_borrowed_items.title: Borrowed items
requisition_borrowed_items.description: Returnable stock still out, with what is overdue against the factory’s own limit.

compliance_bond_utilisation.title: Bond utilisation
compliance_bond_utilisation.description: What each licence entitles the factory to import, against what has actually arrived.

compliance_ud_reconciliation.title: UD/UP vs actual consumption
compliance_ud_reconciliation.description: What each declaration told customs would be consumed, against what the store actually issued.

compliance_duty_summary.title: Duty exemption summary
compliance_duty_summary.description: Duty that fell due when goods left the bond, and what took them out of it.

report.pdf_truncated: Only the first :n rows are in this PDF — export Excel for the whole report.

qt_daily_summary.title: Daily quality summary
qt_daily_summary.description: Day by day, every line and job: target, RFT, defect, rectify, reject, pass, DHU, RFT %, achievement and efficiency.

qt_defect_analysis.title: Defect analysis
qt_defect_analysis.description: Each defect over the period: how often it was found, its share of the section, and on how many lines and jobs.

qt_inspector_performance.title: QC performance
qt_inspector_performance.description: Each QC over the period: days tapped, garments checked, defects found and the DHU they recorded.

qt_hourly_tally.title: Hourly tally
qt_hourly_tally.description: The tally sheet for every line: day, line and hour with RFT, defect, rectify, reject, pass and DHU.

descriptions.sd-settings: Document number prefixes, alert windows and the rules the business decides — ship against delivered, required export documents.
descriptions.sales-order: Customer orders — buyer, style, PO, quantity by colour and size, rate, delivery and shipment dates.
descriptions.so-amendment: Controlled changes to an approved order — previous and revised quantity, price and dates, approved before they apply.
descriptions.order-confirmation: The order approval chain — submitted, checked, approved and confirmed — and the printed confirmation.
descriptions.delivery-chalan: The chalan raised when goods leave the gate, item-wise against its sales order.
descriptions.delivery-challan-return: Goods coming back on a delivered chalan, putting the quantity back on the order's balance.
descriptions.check-bill: Bills verified against the chalan and the order rate, approved and marked paid.
descriptions.delivery-completion: Order-wise delivered, returned, net delivered and balance — pending, partial or completed.
descriptions.so-month-closing: Month-end closing of sales orders — what is still open, and the lock on the period.
descriptions.sc-delivery-list: Goods delivered out to a sub-contractor, with the challan and quantity sent.
descriptions.sc-receive-list: Goods received back from a sub-contractor, reconciled against what was sent.
descriptions.sc-pending: What is still out with each sub-contractor, against its expected return date, overdue first.
descriptions.sc-return: Received goods sent back to the sub-contractor — a rejection returned for rework.
descriptions.sc-reconciliation: Delivered against received, rejected and short for each S/C chalan, reconciled to zero.
descriptions.shipment-planning: Shipments planned against a confirmed order — partial shipments, ex-factory date, destination and quantity.
descriptions.shipment-booking: Space booked with a forwarder or shipping line — vessel, voyage, ETD, ETA and ports.
descriptions.container-vessel: The containers a shipment is loaded into — seal, weights, CBM, cartons and vessel.
descriptions.commercial-doc-handover: Shipment documents handed from the commercial desk to shipping, and who received them.
descriptions.shipment-invoice: The commercial invoice for a shipment — consignee, terms, lines and currency-wise totals.
descriptions.packing-list: Carton-wise packing by colour and size, with pieces, weights and CBM.
descriptions.shipment-confirmation: The pre-shipment checklist — quantity, invoice, packing list, container, booking and documents — and the confirmation.
descriptions.shipment-closing: Confirmed shipments closed with their invoice value, vessel, containers and documents on record.
descriptions.export-documents: The EXP and the inspection, insurance and other export documents on a shipment's checklist.
descriptions.certificate-management: Certificates issued for a shipment, typed from the Certificate Master, with expiry tracking.
descriptions.certificate-of-origin: Certificates of origin filed against each shipment.
descriptions.gsp-rex: GSP forms and REX statements that carry a shipment's preferential tariff.
descriptions.bl-awb: The bill of lading or air waybill a shipment travels on.
descriptions.document-handover: The final set of shipment documents handed to the buyer or the bank, sender and receiver on record.
descriptions.shipment-attachments: Scans and files kept against a shipment, by document type and uploader.
descriptions.order-tracking: One sales order traced from booking to closing.
descriptions.sd-alerts: Live sales and shipment alerts, each with the screen it is cleared on.

set.cert_hint: How far ahead an expiring certificate or export document is flagged. 1 to 365.
set.prefix_hint: 2 to 6 capital letters, different from every other series.
set.width_hint: Digits in the running number: :n prints :example. 4 to 8.
set.footer: Saved settings apply to every new Sales & Shipment number from now on.
set.read_only: Your role can view these settings but not change them.
set.search: Search the Sales & Shipment settings: shipping rules, alert windows, document numbering

v.scd_contract_fixed: :no keeps the contract it was raised against.

ed.no_records: No records to choose from yet.
ed.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
ed.pick_left: Pick the order on the left-hand list and this fills in with it.

entry.title: Sales Order Entry
entry.hint: Book a customer order: the master data, the item lines, the sizes under each line and the particulars that travel with them are saved together.

so.locked: :no is :status — it changes only through a Sales Order Amendment now.

f.so_no_hint: Issued on save, from the receive date and that day's sequence.
f.same_as_bill_to_hint: Ticked, the delivery party is taken from Bill To on save.
f.lead_time_hint: Derived on save: receive date to delivery target.
f.conv_rate_hint: Local currency per unit of the order currency.
f.additional_qty_hint: Overage the customer allows. Deliveries beyond order plus overage are refused.
f.additional_qty_ph: additional % of total sales delivery qty
f.shipment_date_hint: The buyer's ship date. It cannot fall before the receive date.
f.items_hint: The item family this order is placed for. Each line may still name its own.
f.is_poly_hint: Poly and cartons are ordered by weight rather than by piece.
f.note: Buyer, Style and Order match the references written on the order's own lines; every other box narrows the header. Leave them all blank and the most recent orders are listed.

lines.title: Details Data — item lines
lines.hint: One row per item, colour and rate. SL# numbers the line; the two grids below hang their rows off it.
lines.empty: A sales order with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.

sizes.title: GMT Size | Product
sizes.hint: The size band under an item line. SL# is the line's number in the grid above.
sizes.empty: An order line with no size has no quantity — add at least one row per line.

part.title: Other Particular
part.hint: Named attributes carried on an item line — the pairs the printed grid adds with its plus button.
part.empty: Optional. An order line needs no particulars to be complete.

so.empty_title: No sales order matches that search
so.footer: A new order is saved as a draft; submit it for approval on Order Confirmation. Saving replaces a draft's lines with exactly what is in the three grids. Once an order has been submitted it can no longer be edited here — raise a Sales Order Amendment instead.

sc.title: S/C Programme
sc.hint: Put a sales order's work out to a sub-contractor. The programme number this writes is the SC No the two S/C lists are read by.

lines.title: Programme Lines
lines.hint: What is going out, and at what rate the party is paid.
lines.empty: Pick an order on the left to load its lines.

sc.order_fixed: A saved programme keeps its order — clear the form to start a new one.
sc.footer: Pick an order on the left; its lines drop into the grid with the quantity still to be delivered. A line going out at zero is left off the programme.

am.title: Sales Order Amendment Entry
am.hint: Change an approved order's quantities, prices or dates without overwriting it: the amendment records what each figure was and what it becomes, and is applied only once approved.
am.locked: :no is :status — only a draft is edited.
am.order_fixed: A saved amendment keeps its order — clear the form to start a new one.

f.reason_ph: Why the order is changing — buyer revision, price renegotiation…
f.revised_shipment_hint: Left blank, the order keeps its current shipment date.
f.note: Every amendment ever raised against an order is kept, applied or not — read together they are the order's version history.

lines.title: Size-wise Revision
lines.hint: One row per size band. The current quantity and rate are the order's own and are shown, not typed.
lines.empty: Pick an order on the left to load its sizes.

confirm.submit: Submitting sends the amendment for approval. It can no longer be edited.
confirm.approve: Approving records you as the approver of these revised figures.
confirm.reject: Rejecting closes the amendment. The order stays as it is.
confirm.apply: Applying writes the revised quantities, rates and dates onto the order and moves it to the next version. The order as it stands now is kept as a snapshot.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling withdraws the amendment. The order stays as it is.

done.apply: :no applied — the order moved to its next version.

am.footer: Pick the order on the left; its sizes drop into the grid with today's quantity and rate. Type the revised figures and a reason. A line cannot go below what has already been delivered or planned for shipment. An amendment is edited only while it is a draft, and an order carries one open amendment at a time.

f.note: Buyer matches the buyer written on the order's own lines; every other box narrows the header. Leave them all blank and the most recent orders are listed.

oc.empty_title: No order confirmation matches that search

confirm.submit: Submitting sends the order for checking. It can no longer be edited on the entry form unless it is returned to draft.
confirm.approve: Approving records you as the approver of this order's quantities, prices and dates.
confirm.confirm: Confirming finalizes the order: it can be delivered and shipped against, and from now on it changes only through a Sales Order Amendment.
confirm.return: Returning to draft clears the approval trail so the order can be corrected and submitted again.
confirm.close: Closing ends the order: nothing more can be delivered, shipped or amended against it.

done.confirm: :no confirmed — it can be delivered against now.

dc.title: Delivery Chalan Entry
dc.hint: Raise the chalan the goods leave the gate on. Pick the sales order on the left and the lines still to ship drop into the grid.
dc.locked: :no is :status — its lines can no longer be changed.
dc.order_fixed: A saved chalan keeps its order — clear the form to start a new one.

f.store_hint: Delivery Through — the store the goods physically leave from.
f.gate_pass_hint: Issued with the chalan number, so the gate and the desk quote the same reference.
f.note: Buyer, Style, Order and Section match the references on the delivered order lines; the rest narrow the chalan header.

side.title: SO List
side.search: Search SO No, PO/WO or customer…

lines.title: Details Data
lines.hint: What is going out on this chalan. Ordered, already delivered and the balance are the order's own figures and are shown, not typed.
lines.empty: Warning! Please select at least one SO item — pick a sales order on the left to load its lines.

dc.empty_title: No delivery chalan matches that search

confirm.submit: Submitting hands the chalan to the gate. Its lines can no longer be changed.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling releases the delivered quantity back onto the sales order.

done.cancel: :no cancelled — its quantity is back on the order.

dc.footer: Only a confirmed order can be shipped against. A line cannot ship more than the order still owes — ordered, less delivered, plus whatever has come back on confirmed returns — plus whatever overage the order allows. Saving replaces the chalan's lines with exactly what is in the grid; a chalan that has been billed or returned against is locked.

dr.title: Delivery Challan Return Entry
dr.hint: Record goods a customer sends back against a delivery challan. Pick the challan on the left and its lines drop in with what was delivered and what has already come back.
dr.locked: :no is :status — a confirmed or cancelled return is locked.
dr.challan_fixed: A saved return keeps its challan — clear the form to start a new one.

f.note: A draft return changes nothing. Confirming it puts the returned quantity back on the order's delivery balance; cancelling a confirmed one takes it off again.

side.title: Delivered Challan List
side.search: Search chalan no, SO no or customer…

lines.title: Returned Goods
lines.hint: One row per challan line. Item, delivered quantity and what earlier returns brought back are the challan's own facts and are shown, not typed. Leave a line at zero to return none of it.
lines.empty: Pick a delivered challan on the left to load the lines that can be returned.

dr.empty_title: No challan return matches that search

confirm.confirm: Confirming puts the returned quantity back on the sales order's delivery balance. The return can no longer be edited.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling a confirmed return takes the quantity back off the order's delivery balance.

done.confirm: :no confirmed — the quantity is back on the order.

dr.footer: A line cannot return more than the challan delivered, less every other return against it that is not cancelled. Saving keeps the return as a draft — the order's delivery balance changes only when the return is confirmed on the register. A confirmed or cancelled return is locked.

cb.title: Check Bill Entry
cb.hint: Bill the deliveries a customer has taken. Pick a challan on the left and its lines drop in with the delivered quantity beside the box you bill.
cb.locked: :no is :status — a verified, approved or paid bill is locked.
cb.other_customer: :no is another customer's challan — one bill is for one customer.
cb.customer_fixed: Remove the lines first to bill another customer.

f.loc_rate_hint: BDT per unit of the bill currency. The BDT column is struck at this rate.
f.deduction_hint: Taken off the gross of the lines, in the bill currency — short delivery, quality claim, discount. Net = Gross − Deduction.
f.remarks_hint: [BILL_NO], [BILL_DATE] and [SECTION] are filled in from the bill on save.
f.remarks_default: Being the amount party debited for [SECTION] bill purpose as enclosed bill no [BILL_NO] bill date :[BILL_DATE].
f.action_status_hint: A draft can still be edited; a submitted bill waits on the approver.
f.note: A submitted bill is verified, then approved, then paid. It is finalized once approved — the quantities on it are then locked against the challans they were drawn from. A verified bill can no longer be edited; reject it to send it back.

lines.title: Bill Details
lines.hint: One row per delivered line. Challan, item, delivered quantity, unit and what is already billed are the challan's own facts and are shown, not typed.
lines.empty: Pick a delivery challan on the left to load the lines it can be billed for.

cb.empty_title: No check bill matches that search

confirm.verify: Verifying confirms the quantities, rates and deduction against the challans. The bill can no longer be edited.
confirm.approve: Approving finalizes the bill and locks the challans it draws on.
confirm.pay: Marking the bill paid records that the customer has settled it.
confirm.reject: Rejecting sends the bill back to the desk that raised it.

cb.footer: A line cannot be billed for more than was delivered, less whatever another bill has already claimed. Net is the gross of the lines less the deduction. Save keeps the bill as a draft; Submit For Approval sends it to verification, and a verified, approved or paid bill is locked.
cb.saved: Check bill :no saved as a draft.

f.note: Net Delivered is delivered less confirmed returns; Balance is Order Qty less Net Delivered. Days counts to the delivery target — negative once it has passed.

mc.title: Parameters
mc.note: Show Exception lists everything in the month that would stop the close — undelivered orders, open chalans, bills not yet approved, orders whose shipment is still pending, draft challan and S/C returns, and amendments not yet applied. Month Close refuses while any of them stand, unless an administrator ticks the override.

f.period_hint: The month being locked. Both 2026-07 and Jul/2026 are accepted.
f.remarks_ph: Why this month is being closed…
f.override_hint: Only an administrator may close a month that still has exceptions. The override and what was open are recorded with the close.

mc.need_period: Type the month first — 2026-07 or Jul/2026.

confirm.close: Closing locks the month: no order, chalan, bill, return or S/C paper may be dated inside it afterwards.
confirm.reopen: Reopening unlocks the month and releases the orders it closed. Anything posted afterwards falls into an already-reported period.

ex.title: What would stop :period closing
ex.none: Nothing stands in the way — the month can be closed.

mc.empty_title: No month has been closed against sales orders yet.
mc.empty_text: Close a month above once everything in it is settled.

scd.title: Sales Contract Delivery Entry
scd.hint: Send a sub-contract's work out to the party. Pick the contract on the left and its outstanding lines drop into the grid.
scd.locked: :no is :status — it can no longer be rewritten.
scd.contract_fixed: A saved chalan keeps its contract — clear the form to start a new one.

f.transfer_from_hint: Set only when the goods move party to party without coming back through the gate.
f.note: The dates narrow on the delivery target, which is what the sub-contract is chased on — not on the day the chalan was written.

side.title: SC List
side.search: Search SC No, SO No or party…

lines.hint: What is going out to the party. Contracted, already sent and the balance are the contract's own figures.
lines.empty: Warning! Please select at least one Sales Contract item — pick a contract on the left to load its lines.

scd.empty_title: No S/C delivery chalan matches that search

confirm.finalize: Finalising locks the chalan. Its lines can no longer be changed, and only receipts may be booked against it.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling releases the quantity back onto the sales contract.

scd.footer: A line cannot send out more than the contract still owes. A finalized chalan is locked, and one with receipts against it can no longer be rewritten.

scr.title: SC Receive Entry
scr.hint: Book back what the sub-contractor returns. Pick the challan on the left and the lines still out drop into the grid.
scr.locked_note: :no is :status — its quantities can no longer be changed.
scr.chalan_fixed: A saved receipt keeps its challan — clear the form to start a new one.

f.note: Finished goods, left-over material and rejections are all receipts and are told apart by Receive Type — an S/C balance that cannot separate them is not a balance.

side.title: S/C Challan List
side.search: Search chalan no, SC no or party…

lines.hint: What came back. Sent, already returned and the balance are the challan's own figures.
lines.empty: Pick an S/C challan on the left to load the lines still out with the party.

scr.empty_title: No S/C receipt matches that search

confirm.finalize: Finalising locks the receipt. Its quantities can no longer be changed.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling takes the received quantity back off the S/C balance.

scr.footer: Finished goods, left-over material and rejections are all receipts and are told apart by Receive Type. A line cannot come back for more than went out on that challan.

f.note: Pending is what went out, less what came back, plus what was sent back out again. A line is overdue once its chalan's delivery target has passed with anything still pending. A reconciled (closed) chalan counts as completed — whatever it was short was written off there.

scp.empty_title: Nothing is out with a sub-contractor for that search

sct.title: Sub-Contract Return Entry
sct.hint: Send received goods back to the sub-contractor. Pick the receipt on the left and the lines that can still go back drop into the grid.
sct.receipt_fixed: A saved return keeps its receipt — clear the form to start a new one.

f.note: Only a confirmed return moves the S/C balance. A draft is a return nobody has agreed to yet, and a cancelled one sends nothing.

side.title: S/C Receive List
side.search: Search MRR no, chalan no or party…

lines.hint: What goes back to the party. Received, rejected and previously returned are the receipt's own figures.
lines.empty: Pick an S/C receipt on the left to load the lines that can still be sent back.

sct.empty_title: No S/C return matches that search

confirm.confirm: Confirming puts the returned quantity back out with the party on the S/C chalan. The return can no longer be edited.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling takes the returned quantity back off the S/C chalan's pending balance.

done.confirm: :no confirmed — the quantity is back out with the party.

sct.footer: A line cannot send back more than came in on that receipt line, less what other returns already send back. Saving keeps the return a draft; it moves nothing until it is confirmed on the register.

scc.title: Sub-Contract Reconciliation Entry
scc.hint: Square an S/C chalan against what came back. Pick the chalan on the left, record anything agreed short, and save to work out the balance.
scc.locked_note: :no is reconciled — locked until an administrator reopens it.
scc.chalan_fixed: A saved reconciliation keeps its chalan — clear the form to start a new one.

f.note: Pending still has goods out with the party. Matched, Short and Excess are squared and can be reconciled, which closes the S/C chalan.

lines.hint: One line per chalan line. The quantities are the chalan's own; Balance is what is still out less what is short, and is worked out when you save.
lines.empty: Pick an S/C chalan on the left to load its lines.

confirm.reconcile: Reconciling signs the chalan off and closes it. The figures are locked, and only an administrator can reopen it.
confirm.reopen: Reopening un-closes the S/C chalan and unlocks the reconciliation for changes.

scc.footer: Delivered, received, rejected and returned are read off the chalan when you save — only Short is yours to enter. Short cannot exceed what is still out. A chalan has one open reconciliation at a time, and a reconciled one is locked until an administrator reopens it.

sp.title: Shipment Plan Entry
sp.hint: Plan one shipment of a confirmed order. Pick the order on the left and the lines still to plan drop into the grid.
sp.locked: :no is :stage — the plan can no longer be rewritten here.
sp.order_fixed: A saved plan keeps its order — clear the form to start a new one.

f.order_hint: Only confirmed orders are offered. Pick one on the left and this fills in with it.
f.ex_factory_hint: The day the goods leave the factory — on or before the shipment date.
f.note: The dates narrow on the shipment date the buyer expects, not on the day the plan was written.

side.title: Order List
side.search: Search SO No, PO or customer…

lines.title: Planned Lines
lines.hint: What ships on this plan. Order qty, what other shipments have already planned and the balance are the order's own figures and are shown, not typed.
lines.empty: A shipment plan needs at least one order line — pick a confirmed order on the left to load its lines.

sp.empty_title: No shipment plan matches that search

confirm.cancel: Cancelling releases the planned quantity back onto the sales order. Its booking and documents stay on file against a cancelled shipment.

done.cancel: :no cancelled — its quantity is back on the order.

sp.against_delivered: Ship Against Delivered is on in the settings: a line plans no more than the order has net delivered, less what other shipments planned.
sp.footer: A line cannot plan more than the order still has unplanned, counting every other shipment that is not cancelled. Saving replaces the plan's lines with exactly what is in the grid; once an invoice or a packing list has been raised on the shipment its lines are locked.
sp.papered: :no has an invoice or a packing list — its plan lines are locked.

f.shipment_hint: Only shipments still being prepared are offered.

bk.title: Shipment Booking
bk.hint: Book space for a shipment with a forwarder or shipping line.
bk.note: The booking number is issued on save. A booking counts towards the shipment's shipping details once it is confirmed and carries a vessel and an ETD.

f.eta_hint: Must not fall before the ETD.

confirm.confirm: Confirming records that the line has accepted the booking.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling withdraws the booking. The shipment will need another before it can be confirmed.

ct.title: Container / Vessel Details
ct.hint: Record a container a shipment is loaded into.
ct.note: Vessel, voyage, ETD and ETA left blank are taken from the booking. A container number is four letters and seven digits, and appears once per shipment.

f.booking_hint: Choosing a booking fills in its vessel, voyage and dates.
f.type_hint: Left blank, the booking's container type is used.

dh.title: Commercial Document Handover
dh.hint: Commercial → Shipping: the documents of a shipment handed over, and who received them.
dh.note: Commercial → Shipping. The handover number is issued on save. Move it along with the row actions — Mark Received needs the receiver's name on record. A received handover is locked; only a pending one can be removed.

f.list_hint: Anything handed over beyond the invoice, packing list, EXP and certificate above.
f.attachment_hint: The scanned papers — PDF or image, up to 10 MB.
f.attached: Attached: :name — choose a file to replace it.

confirm.returned: Marking returned records that the documents came back — they will need handing over again.

dh.upload_failed: The handover was saved, but the attachment did not upload.

si.title: Shipment Invoice Entry
si.hint: Raise the commercial invoice for a shipment. Pick the shipment on the left and its un-invoiced lines drop into the grid.
si.locked: :no is :status — only a draft can be changed.
si.shipment_fixed: A saved paper keeps its shipment — clear the form to start a new one.

f.commercial_hint: The Commercial module's invoice for the same consignment, when there is one.
f.note: Currency totals above the list leave cancelled invoices out — a cancelled invoice bills nothing.

lines.title: Invoice Lines
lines.hint: What this invoice bills. The quantity opens on what is still un-invoiced on the shipment line.
lines.empty: Pick a shipment on the left to load its lines — an invoice with no lines bills nothing.

si.empty_title: No shipment invoice matches that search

confirm.finalize: Finalizing locks the invoice. It then counts towards the shipment's readiness and cannot be edited, only cancelled.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling releases the invoiced quantity back onto the shipment lines.

si.footer: Only a shipment that has not been confirmed can be invoiced. A line cannot invoice more than the shipment carries less what other live invoices already claim. Amount is Qty × Unit Price, worked out again on save. Only a draft invoice can be changed or removed; finalize it from the register once it is right.

pl.title: Packing List Entry
pl.hint: Pack a shipment carton by carton. Pick the shipment on the left and its unpacked lines drop into the grid; type each carton range and its pack size.

f.invoice_hint: The shipment invoice these cartons travel under, when it has been raised.

lines.title: Carton-wise Packing
lines.hint: One row per carton run. A shipment line packed in several colours, sizes or pack sizes takes several rows.
lines.empty: Pick a shipment on the left to load its lines — a packing list with no cartons packs nothing.

pl.empty_title: No packing list matches that search

confirm.finalize: Finalizing locks the packing list. It then counts towards the shipment's readiness.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling releases the packed pieces back onto the shipment lines.

pl.footer: Cartons is To − From + 1 and PCS is Cartons × PCS/Carton, both worked out on save. Carton ranges must start at 1 or above and may not overlap within the list. A shipment line cannot be packed beyond its shipment quantity across all live packing lists. Gross weight may not be below net weight. Only a draft packing list can be changed.

f.title: Checklist
f.note: Confirm refuses until every check passes. Confirming writes the quantities on the shipment's final invoices as shipped, against the shipment and its order.
f.shipment_hint: Search narrows the list to it; Check lists its readiness in full.

hint.qty: Final invoices bill something, never more than the shipment carries, and the final packing lists pack exactly what they bill.
hint.booking: A confirmed or completed booking with a vessel and an ETD.
hint.container: At least one container — needed for sea and sea-air shipments.
hint.invoice: At least one final shipment invoice.
hint.packing: At least one final packing list.
hint.documents: With export documents required in the settings, the EXP and the B/L or AWB filed (Export Documentation).

confirm.confirm: Confirming declares the goods shipped. The final invoices' quantities are written onto the shipment and the sales order.
confirm.unconfirm: Unconfirming takes the shipped quantities back off the shipment and its order, and returns it to the stage its paperwork shows.

confirm.close: Closing marks the shipment's file complete. Only an administrator can reopen it.
confirm.reopen: Reopening puts the shipment back among the confirmed ones, so its file can be corrected.

cl.empty_text: Shipments appear here once they are confirmed on Shipment Confirmation.

ed.note: A document number is unique per document type. A closed or cancelled shipment takes no further documents. The Expiry column warns inside the alert window set in Sales & Shipment settings.

f.shipment_hint: A closed or cancelled shipment takes no further documents.

confirm.delete: Remove this document from its shipment?

export.title: EXP / Export Documents
export.hint: File the EXP and the inspection, insurance and other export documents on a shipment's checklist.
export.empty_title: No export documents document matches that search

coo.title: COO / Certificate of Origin
coo.hint: File a certificate of origin against a shipment.
coo.empty_title: No certificate of origin document matches that search

gsp.title: GSP / REX
gsp.hint: File the GSP form or REX statement that carries a shipment's preferential tariff.
gsp.empty_title: No gsp / rex document matches that search

blawb.title: Bill of Lading / AWB
blawb.hint: File the bill of lading or air waybill a shipment travels on.
blawb.empty_title: No B/L / AWB document matches that search

ce.title: Certificate Management
ce.hint: Record a certificate issued for a shipment.
ce.note: A certificate number is unique within its shipment. Validity is worked out from the expiry date against the alert window in Sales & Shipment settings. A closed or cancelled shipment's certificates can no longer be changed.

f.type_hint: From the Certificate Master (Company Documents). Brings its issuing authority with it.
f.name: Certificate Name
f.name_hint: Left blank, the certificate type's title.

confirm.delete: Remove this certificate from its shipment?

fh.title: Document Handover
fh.hint: The final set of shipment documents handed to the buyer or the bank.
fh.note: Final Handover. The handover number is issued on save. Move it along with the row actions — Mark Received needs the receiver's name on record. A received handover is locked; only a pending one can be removed.

f.list_hint: The documents handed to the buyer or the bank — one per line, as they are checked off.

fh.empty_title: No document handover matches that search

sa.title: Shipment Attachments
sa.hint: Keep a scan or file against a shipment.
sa.note: Only PDF, PNG, JPEG and WebP files of up to 5 MB are accepted. Editing without choosing a new file keeps the one already attached.

f.title: File Name
f.title_hint: How the document is referred to — the stored file is renamed on upload.
f.file_hint: PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB.

confirm.delete: Remove this attachment from its shipment?

sr.title: Sales & Shipment Reports
sr.hint: The module's report set. Pick one, narrow it with the boxes it takes, and Preview runs it against the live tables.
sr.note: A box the chosen report does not read is disabled rather than hidden, so the parameters stay in the same place whichever report is picked. Values on the Sales & Shipment reports are in BDT, converted at each challan's own rate and at the order's rate for order lines and shipment invoices. Pending is Order Qty less the larger of net delivered and shipped, so goods delivered and then shipped are not counted twice. A status applies only to the report it names.

kind.monthly-sales-summary: Monthly Sales Summary (by order month, BDT)

ot.title: Order Timeline
ot.caption: Every event on one sales order in the order it happened — approval, amendments, deliveries and returns, bills, sub-contract papers, shipment documents, confirmation and closing — with its date, reference, quantity, value, status and who acted
ot.order_hint: Every order is offered, newest first — a closed order can still be traced.
ot.pick: Pick a sales order and press Load to trace it from booking to closing.
ot.note: Delivery Balance is Order Qty less Net Delivered (delivered less returned); Shipment Balance is Order Qty less Shipped. When the module ships against delivered goods, Available is what has been delivered and not yet shipped, and Balance is Order Qty less the larger of Net Delivered and Shipped, so a carton delivered and then shipped is counted once. Otherwise delivery and shipment are separate ways out, Available is the Shipment Balance, and the two balances are read on their own.
ot.empty: No event on this order yet.
ot.head: :no · :customer

against.off: Delivery and shipment are separate ways out

al.title: Alerts
al.caption: Live sales and shipment alerts with their kind, severity, document reference, party, due date, days to or past it, detail and the screen each is cleared on
al.note: Worked out from the papers each time the screen opens — nothing to dismiss: an alert clears itself once its paper moves on. Due alerts look :days days ahead and certificates :cert days ahead (Sales & Shipment Settings).
al.empty_title: No alert — every order and shipment is on time

d.closing: All :qty delivered or shipped — the order can be closed
d.subcon: :back of :qty back · :out still with the party

scan.not_found_title: This code doesn't match any machine you can reach
scan.not_found_hint: It may belong to a different company, or the label may be damaged. Ask your supervisor if this seems wrong.
scan.location_not_found_title: This code doesn't match any location you can reach
scan.location_not_found_hint: It may belong to a different company, or the label may be damaged. Ask your supervisor if this seems wrong.
scan.what_would_you_like_to_do: What would you like to do?
scan.no_actions: You have no actions available on this asset.
scan.no_assets_here: Nothing is recorded at this location
scan.no_assets_here_hint: Either the location is empty, or an asset here has not been registered yet.
scan.label_hint: Print on adhesive stock. Minimum 20 mm square when printed; smaller will not scan reliably from an oily machine frame.
scan.label_truncated: Showing the first 200 labels. Narrow the filter to print the rest.
scan.no_labels_hint: Register an asset first, or widen the filter.
scan.regenerate_qr_confirm: This invalidates the label currently stuck to the machine. It must be reprinted and replaced. Continue?
scan.qr_regenerated: A new QR token was issued (:code). Reprint and replace the label on the machine.

settings.intro: How this company wants the product to behave. Several of these change what a number means rather than how a screen looks — whether planned downtime counts against availability, what a maintenance date does when it lands on a rest day — so every change here is recorded in the audit log.
settings.scope_hint: Some settings can be answered again for a single factory. A factory that has not answered follows the company, and keeps following it when the company changes its mind.
